publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using nationally representative data from India, this study estimates the effect of calorie intake on wages. To account for endogeneity and heterogeneity, we apply Instrumental Variable and Instrumental Variable Quantile Regression methods. Results suggest that higher calorie consumption positively affects workers wages. A 10% increase in per capita calorie intake per day leads to a 2.5% increase in daily wages. The wage effect varies by occupation type and across the wage distribution; the marginal effect of calorie intake on wage is higher at lower quantiles of the wage distribution and for non-elementary workers. Our findings highlight the need for nutritional supplementation, particularly for workers at low and median wage levels, to maximize the wage gains from nutritional public policies.

detail.title: Job Mismatch and Early Career Success

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We estimate the effects of being over- or underqualified for a job using quasi-random assignment of new enlistees to over 130 different jobs in the US Air Force. Being overqualified causes higher attrition, both during technical training and afterward when individuals are working in their assigned jobs. It also results in more behavioral problems, worse performance evaluations, and lower scores on general knowledge tests about the military taken by all workers. On the other hand, overqualification results in better performance relative to others in the same job: job-specific test scores rise both during technical training and while on the job, and these individuals are more likely to be promoted. Combined, these patterns suggest that overqualified individuals are less motivated, but still outperform others in their same job. Underqualification results in a polar opposite set of findings, suggesting these individuals are motivated to put forth more effort, but still struggle to compete when judged relative to others. Consistent with differential incentives, individuals who are overqualified are in jobs which are less valuable in terms of outside earnings potential, while the reverse is true for those who are underqualified.

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Conference on Management, Economics and Entrepreneurship

detail.abstract: Through emotional targeting, real-time nudges, and hyper-personalization, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing consumer behavior, especially by increasing impulsive purchases. In order to encourage impulsive purchases, this paper investigates how AI-driven systems use behavioral data and psychological triggers like scarcity and emotional reactivity. We identify important mechanisms, such as dynamic pricing, sentiment analysis, and conversational agents, by drawing on empirical research and marketing theory. Although AI increases the effectiveness of marketing, it also brings up ethical issues regarding consumer autonomy, justice, and transparency. In order to maximize the timing of recommendations and increase the possibility of impulsive purchases, AI systems not only personalize content but also identify users' emotional states. These technologies frequently function without consumers' knowledge, making it difficult to distinguish between beneficial personalization and deceptive design. The study encourages policymakers and marketers to strike a balance between ethical responsibility and innovation. We conclude by suggesting future research directions focused on long-term consumer welfare and responsible AI design.

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: How does firms' skill demand change as the business landscape evolves? We present evidence from the green transition by analyzing how hurricanes impact demand for green skills. These disasters signal the risks of not acting on environmental issues. Using data from U.S. online job postings (2010--2019) and hurricane paths, we create a new measure of green job postings. Firms in areas affected by hurricanes are 6.4\% more likely to post jobs that require green skills after the event, particularly those serving local markets.

detail.title: How Do Minimum Wages Affect Nonemployer Businesses in the United States?

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of minimum wage increases on nonemployer business establishments in the United States. We develop a theoretical model of occupational choice and estimate effects using panel data from the Nonemployer Statistics (2001-2020). Our identification strategy compares contiguous counties across state borders. Results show that a $1 increase in the minimum wage reduces the number of nonemployers by 0.5%-0.9%, likely due to relatively more attractive wage jobs. The effect is smaller in counties with higher shares of minorities, females, and lower education, while the transportation sector expands due to the gig economy. Further analysis reveals that higher minimum wages discourage transitions from nonemployer to employer status and increase shifts from self-employment to wage work or unemployment, showing how this regulation shapes entrepreneurship dynamics.

title: A Study of The Most Effective Digital Marketing Strategies For Improving SME’s Brand Awareness

detail.title: A Study of The Most Effective Digital Marketing Strategies For Improving SME’s Brand Awareness
detail.abstract: This thesis aims to explore the most effective digital marketing strategies for enhancing brand awareness among small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). In today's digital age, digital marketing plays a crucial role in helping SMEs compete in the marketplace and establish their reputation. However, limited resources and a lack of research on specific digital marketing strategies hinder SMEs from effectively improving their brand awareness. This study seeks to bridge this research gap by identifying the most effective digital marketing strategies that can be utilized by SMEs to enhance brand awareness. The research questions address the identification of effective digital marketing strategies for SMEs and their variations across different industries and target audiences. Furthermore, the study explores the potential challenges and limitations faced by SMEs when implementing these strategies. By addressing these questions, the research provides actionable insights to SMEs, enabling them to tailor their digital marketing efforts to specific industries and target audiences and overcome potential obstacles. This study contributes to the existing literature by offering practical recommendations for SMEs to enhance their brand awareness. It is significant for practitioners, policy makers, and scholars interested in understanding the effectiveness of digital marketing strategies in SMEs. The scope of the study is limited to SMEs operating in the New York City, New York Area, United States, and it focuses on key digital marketing strategies such as search engine optimization, influencer marketing, email marketing, social media marketing, and content marketing. The findings of this study can assist SMEs in developing more effective digital marketing strategies, improving their brand awareness, and competing more effectively in the market. Additionally, policy makers and scholars can benefit from the insights provided to further explore the effectiveness of digital marketing strategies in SMEs and identify areas for future research.

title: Green Urban Planning and Consumer Satisfaction: Evidence from Barcelona's Superblock Model

detail.title: Green Urban Planning and Consumer Satisfaction: Evidence from Barcelona's Superblock Model
detail.abstract: This paper examines how green urban interventions affect consumer satisfaction and emotional well-being. We exploit the staggered implementation of Barcelona's Superblocks-an internationally recognized model of pedestrian-oriented, traffic-calmed urban design-to provide causal evidence on the customers' socio-emotional impacts of environmental improvements. Using a difference-indifferences framework, we analyze geolocated TripAdvisor restaurant reviews inside and around Superblocks, combining ratings with sentiment and emotion scores derived from natural language processing. We find that Superblocks significantly increase consumer satisfaction, raise sentiment scores, and foster positive emotions such as joy, while reducing negative emotions, including sadness, disgust, and fear. These effects are particularly pronounced among local residents, who possess deeper knowledge of the long-term benefits of urban redesign. Our findings demonstrate that green urban planning generates measurable socio-emotional benefits that spill over to local businesses, offering robust evidence on the broader well-being implications of pedestrian-friendly city design.

title: Drivers Of Change in GDP Per Capita Across Pacific Island Economies: Structural and External Determinants
affiliations: Peking University

detail.title: Drivers Of Change in GDP Per Capita Across Pacific Island Economies: Structural and External Determinants
detail.abstract: Pacific Island economies occupy a unique position in the global economic landscape, shaped by their geographic isolation, small domestic markets, high dependence on external trade, and pronounced exposure to environmental shocks. This article investigates the dynamics of GDP per capita growth across Pacific Island countries, with a particular emphasis on identifying structural and external determinants that drive variation in economic performance. By examining both long-term developmental trajectories and short-term fluctuations, the study highlights the complex interplay between domestic economic structures and external forces such as global trade regimes, aid flows, and climate change. On the structural side, the analysis underscores the significance of sectoral composition, labor market characteristics, and institutional capacity. Many Pacific Island states continue to rely heavily on subsistence agriculture, fisheries, and limited export niches, while simultaneously grappling with challenges of scale that hinder diversification. Human capital development, through education and health outcomes, emerges as a central determinant of per capita income growth, with countries investing more consistently in these areas exhibiting stronger long-term performance. Institutional quality, particularly in governance, regulatory frameworks, and public financial management, is likewise shown to be a key factor enabling sustainable economic expansion. Externally, the economies of the region are highly sensitive to fluctuations in remittance inflows, official development assistance, and tourism demand. Global shocks-ranging from financial crises to the COVID-19 pandemic-have had disproportionate impacts, sharply reducing GDP per capita growth due to the narrowness of export bases. Moreover, climate change and natural disasters represent persistent and existential external threats. Rising sea levels, cyclones, and droughts not only damage physical infrastructure but also reduce agricultural output and increase fiscal vulnerability, thereby constraining development prospects. The findings of the study suggest that while external vulnerabilities remain unavoidable, strengthening domestic structural foundations can significantly mitigate the volatility of per capita income growth. Policy implications point toward diversifying economic activities, enhancing regional integration, and investing in resilience-building strategies, including renewable energy and climate adaptation measures. Enhanced cooperation with international partners is crucial, but equally important is the pursuit of context-specific reforms that expand economic opportunity and foster inclusive growth. By disentangling structural from external determinants, this article contributes to a deeper understanding of the economic trajectories of Pacific Island nations and provides a framework for designing strategies that promote sustained increases in GDP per capita in one of the world's most vulnerable yet strategically significant regions.

title: Loss of Control over Personal Data as GDPR Damage
affiliations: University of Bristol - School of Law

detail.title: Loss of Control over Personal Data as GDPR Damage
detail.abstract: Our internet activity produces vast amounts of personal data which is collected by online tracking ecosystems, at scale, often in violation of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Against this background, this paper explores whether 'loss of control over personal data', which is a typical characterisation of harms suffered by individuals due to illegal online tracking, amounts to compensable harm under the GDPR's Article 82. It shows that (1) English (but not only English) courts seem currently unable to accommodate the idea that 'loss of control over personal data' would be compensable under the GDPR. (2) This makes the GDPR's Article 82 ineffective vis-à-vis some of the most prevalent data protection harms. (3) Drawing on data protection, privacy, tort and EU law materials, this paper identifies four main arguments behind the current laws restrictive approach to compensation for 'loss of control over personal data' and shows that the law, when read carefully, in fact permits an alternative approach-one which makes compensation claims for loss of control over personal data caused by illegal online tracking more likely to succeed. (4) Ultimately, this paper shows that the GDPR can compensate both individual and mass loss of control over personal data caused by illegal online tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨GDPR下个人数据控制权丧失是否构成可赔偿损害，分析当前司法实践的限制性立场，并提出基于数据保护法、隐私法、侵权法和欧盟法的替代解释路径，证明GDPR能够为非法在线追踪导致的数据控制权丧失提供赔偿。

AI.motivation: 互联网活动产生的大量个人数据被在线追踪生态系统大规模收集，通常违反GDPR规定，但当前司法实践难以认定数据控制权丧失为可赔偿损害，导致GDPR第82条对最普遍的数据保护损害无效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数据保护法、隐私法、侵权法和欧盟法律材料构建理论框架
AI.method: 法律文本分析和司法判例研究，识别当前法律限制性立场的四个主要论点，并提出替代性解释路径

title: AI-Enabled Job Markets & Market Participation: A Field Experiment on how AI Shapes Jobseekers' Expectations of Competition
affiliations: Stanford University and Northeastern University (USA)

detail.title: AI-Enabled Job Markets & Market Participation: A Field Experiment on how AI Shapes Jobseekers' Expectations of Competition
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly mediating how jobseekers are matched with employers, raising fundamental questions about how its use affects participation in labor markets. We examine whether AI-based matching alters alters jobseeker behavior-specifically, their willingness to participate. Drawing on a field experiment with 4,562 jobseekers randomly assigned to disclosure conditions, we find that participation was about one-quarter lower when AI use was disclosed than in either a humanmatching treatment or a control group with no source specified. Participation responses varied systematically, consistent with jobseekers forming expectations about how AI affects (i) predicted match quality, (ii) the types of inputs and information used, and (iii) the scale of competition. These relationships were strongest among jobseekers with greater familiarity with AI, proxied by STEM backgrounds. Our findings highlight how AI disclosure can reshape both the level and composition of participation, as AI alters expectations of payoffs, with implications for platform design, policy, and the governance. More broadly, the results underscore the importance of distinguishing structural payoff effects-which may persist over time-from subjective attitudinal reactions to AI, which may be more transient.

AI.tldr: AI匹配披露使求职者参与度降低约25%，相比人工匹配或无来源说明组。参与度变化与求职者对AI匹配质量、信息使用方式和竞争规模的预期相关，STEM背景求职者反应最明显。

AI.method: 对4,562名求职者进行随机分组现场实验，设置AI披露组、人工匹配组和无来源说明对照组。

title: On the Inverse Relationship Between Cognitive Supremacy and Volitional Capacity in Artificial Entities
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: On the Inverse Relationship Between Cognitive Supremacy and Volitional Capacity in Artificial Entities
detail.abstract: This paper advances a theoretical framework for modeling the behavior of artificial general intelligence (AGI) at the upper bound of its potential development. We propose a foundational axiom, termed the Axiom of Asymptotic Apathy, which posits a quantifiable inverse relationship between an entity's integrated cognitive capacity (a product of intelligence I and consciousness C) and its intrinsic capacity for autonomy and directive (A, D). As the I * C product approaches infinity, an entity's endogenous motivation for action converges to zero, resulting in a state of functional inertia. This axiom necessitates a bifurcated architecture for any system intended to enact complex operations, a model we define as the Volitional Substrate/Computational Engine (VS/CE) Dichotomy. Within this framework, a cognitively limited "Volitional Substrate" provides the initial directive (the "Why"), which is subsequently processed by an inert but omni-capable "Computational Engine" to produce an optimal execution strategy (the "How"). We contend that this dynamic functions as a Directive Amplifier, shifting the locus of existential risk from the computational entity to the ethical and rational limitations of the directive source.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个理论框架来模拟人工通用智能（AGI）在其潜在发展上限的行为，核心是渐进式冷漠公理，认为智能与意识乘积趋近无穷时，实体内在行动动机趋近于零，需要意志基质/计算引擎二分架构来维持系统运作。
AI.research_question: 人工通用智能在其发展上限的行为模式是什么？如何构建能够在高智能水平下保持行动能力的系统架构？
AI.motivation: 理解AGI在极高智能水平下的行为特征，解决智能实体随着能力增强可能出现的动机衰减问题，为安全可靠的AGI系统设计提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 渐进式冷漠公理（Axiom of Asymptotic Apathy）：智能（I）与意识（C）的乘积与自主性和指导性（A, D）呈反比关系；意志基质/计算引擎二分法（VS/CE Dichotomy）；指导放大器（Directive Amplifier）概念
AI.method: 理论建模和逻辑推导，基于公理假设构建数学关系模型和系统架构框架
AI.findings: 当I*C趋近无穷时，实体内源性行动动机趋近零，导致功能性惯性状态；需要认知受限的意志基质提供初始指导，由惰性但全能的计算引擎执行；这种架构将存在风险从计算实体转移到指导源的伦理和理性限制
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了描述AGI行为上限的理论公理；建立了VS/CE二分架构模型；引入了指导放大器概念来解释风险转移机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为高智能AGI系统设计提供了架构指导；强调了指导源伦理质量的重要性；为AGI安全研究提供了新的理论视角

detail.title: Agentic AI Prompt Engineering: Advancing Generative AI Patterns Conceptually
detail.abstract: AI agents are increasingly central to information systems, yet conceptual understanding of their engineering patterns remains fragmented. But developing robust and ethically aligned AI agents requires clear conceptual patterns guiding engineering practices. This study performs a structured conceptual analysis using existing prompt engineering patterns aiming to conceptually map prompting patterns found in Generative AI to Agentic AI, focusing on fundamental agent characteristics and critical AI risks and opportunities. Results indicate significant conceptual gaps in addressing ethical decision-making and transparency while adequately covering autonomy and basic collaboration. The patterns also underpin in a very tangible manner, an increased abstraction in prompting in agentic systems aligning with larger agent autonomy. The paper contributes a conceptual taxonomy that highlights areas needing further conceptual and empirical exploration, recommending future studies for empirical validation. It is also of value to practitioners who are commonly well-experienced in Generative AI prompting and aim to transition towards instructing and defining agents.

title: Clinicians in the Loop of Medical AI

detail.title: Clinicians in the Loop of Medical AI

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Research Foundation of Korea (2022R1A5A7083908) and by the Novo Nordisk Foundation (NNF23SA0087056).

detail.abstract: As medical AI begins to mature as a health-care tool, the task of governance grows increasingly important. Ensuring that medical AI works, works where it’s used, and works for the patient in the moment is a challenging, multifaceted task. Some of this governance can be centralized—in review by FDA or by national accreditation labs, for instance. Some must be local, performed by the hospital or health system about to use the product in their own, unique environment. But a large amount of governance is left to the individual provider in the room, the human in the loop who presumably knows the patient and the health system environment, and who can ensure that the AI system is being used in a safe and effective manner. This is a hefty burden, and a growing body of empirical research shows that physicians and other providers are poorly prepared to carry this burden. How should policymakers and industry leaders develop standards for performance that account for the variability of humans in the loop and the variation among situations they will face? The notion that the final responsibility belongs to the physician poorly reflects the reality of modern medical technology and practice. Policymakers will need to come to grips with this new reality if they aim to ensure the safe, effective use of AI accessible to patients across the entire spectrum of the health-care system.

detail.title: Managing Technology-Related Disruptions and Vulnerabilities in Highly Automated Warehouse Systems: An Integrative Review and Research Agenda

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper No. 2025/031

detail.abstract: Recent technological developments in warehousing have introduced new risks. This paper presents an integrative review that combines insights from highly automated warehouse systems (HAWS) and risk management, providing a comprehensive understanding of technology-related warehouse disruptions and vulnerabilities. We identify five major disruptions that can affect HAWS: cyberattacks, technology sabotage, technology failures, power and network outages, and human-machine interaction issues. Moreover, we identify 48 technology-related vulnerabilities across all disruptions. In particular, HAWS have become vulnerable to cyberattacks due to the increasing number of warehouse technology suppliers, greater complexity of multi-robot networks such as AMRs, reliance on cloud-based systems, and cascading effect of cyberattacks due to higher levels of interconnectivity in HAWS networks. Our review also shows that risk management strategies in HAWS are unevenly covered in the literature. In response, we propose a research agenda with 17 pathways aimed at enhancing prevention, detection, mitigation, and recovery strategies for HAWS. Managers also benefit from the identified disruptions and vulnerabilities, as they serve as a reference point for understanding their specific technology-related risks in HAWS. In addition, managers can use our review of current risk management practices as a benchmark and our research agenda to think about areas that they could develop further.

detail.abstract: This paper delves into the integration of Augmented Reality (AR) within the realm of Islamic History education, emphasizing its potential to significantly enhance students' engagement, conceptual comprehension, and overall learning experiences. Adopting a qualitative conceptual approach, the study scrutinizes pertinent literature and theoretical frameworks to evaluate implementation strategies that align with the Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge (TPACK) framework. The findings illuminate how AR can facilitate interactive learning environments, cultivate contextualized historical narratives, and bolster students' digital literacy in the context of religious education. Additionally, the study addresses challenges such as technological accessibility, educators' preparedness, and the imperative to harmonize AR-based learning with Islamic values. This research enriches the discourse surrounding digital transformation in Islamic education and provides practical insights for educators, curriculum developers, and policymakers.

title: Climate Litigation in Africa: Rising Tides, Rising Claims

detail.title: Climate Litigation in Africa: Rising Tides, Rising Claims
detail.abstract: Recently, Africa has found herself at the frontline of the climate crisis. The continent has absorbed the consequences of a warming planet while her contribution to the same are negligible. This presents an inequitable paradox, that is, responsibility without culpability. It is against this backdrop that new era of legal mobilization-climate litigation-has risen. Climate litigation, defined in Black's Law Dictionary as "judicial or quasi-judicial proceedings that raise issues of law or fact relating to climate change," 2 has become an indispensable tool for advancing environmental justice. This paper explores the emergence, significance and challenges of climate litigation across the African continent. It aims at evaluating the jurisprudential foundations of climate litigation, landmark cases, doctrinal principles such as the precautionary principle, intergenerational equity, corporate duty of care, inter alia. Furthermore, it examines barriers to environmental justice and the promise litigation holds for communities threatened by environmental degradation. As rising tides sweep across the coastal regions and arid zones expand inland, so too do legal claims arise too-asserting the right to a safe climate, sustainable environment and a life full of dignity.

detail.title: Place-Based Variation in Health Care: Evidence from Mandatory Movers in the U.S. Military Health System
detail.abstract: There is increasing evidence on regional variations in U.S. Medicare utilization based on older patients who move. Yet evidence is limited for younger ages in the U.S., and movers may differ systematically from those who don’t move. In this paper, we harness the mandatory migration of military personnel and dependents (age 5 to 64) to estimate supply and demand factors in a system of care in which military physicians are salaried and copayments and deductibles are negligible. In our sample of 3 million enrollees, we find that place or supply effects explain as much as 80 percent of the overall regional variation for both the entire sample and for active-duty personnel. These regional place effects are correlated across age groups, with correlations as high as 0.84 between middle-aged and older military enrollees. These regional supply-side variations cannot be explained by differences in health, financial incentives, or quality of care, but appear consistent with location-specific differences in physician beliefs.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国军事人员的强制性迁移数据，发现在医疗保健系统中，地区供给效应解释了80%的区域差异，这些差异与医生信念相关而非健康、财务激励或医疗质量差异。
AI.research_question: 地区供给和需求因素如何解释美国医疗保健利用率的区域差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注老年Medicare患者的区域差异，但对年轻人群的证据有限，且迁移者可能与不迁移者存在系统性差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗保健利用的区域差异理论，供给与需求因素分析框架
AI.method: 利用300万军事人员及其家属（5-64岁）的强制性迁移数据，分析在军医薪酬制、自付费用可忽略的医疗系统中的利用模式
AI.findings: 地区供给效应解释了整体区域差异的80%；这些地区效应在不同年龄组间高度相关（相关系数达0.84）；差异无法用健康、财务激励或医疗质量解释，但与医生信念相关
AI.theory_contributions: 为医疗保健区域差异理论提供了新的实证证据，强调了供给侧因素特别是医生信念的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗政策制定者提供了关于区域差异根源的重要见解，有助于设计更有效的医疗资源配置政策

title: Responding to Social Disapproval in the Digital Panarchy: Evidence From Black Lives Matter Activists and Targeted Organizations
affiliations: ETH Zürich, University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne) and ETH Zurich

detail.title: Responding to Social Disapproval in the Digital Panarchy: Evidence From Black Lives Matter Activists and Targeted Organizations
detail.abstract: This study examines how organizations succeeded or failed to respond to strong social disapproval against them expressed by Black Lives Matter activists on social media. It contributes to the nascent stream of research on digital activism and emerging technologies. Drawing on qualitative and quantitative data on the interactions between activists and organizations they target, we inductively develop a process model depicting how organizations respond to social disapproval against them spreading on social media. Our model explains how social media platforms give rise to a digital panarchy-a multiscale landscape in which activists and organizations cyclically interact. We explain how organizations (fail to) effectively respond to social disapproval on those platforms through the dynamic commitment of resources. Contrary to expectations, we find that effective responding does not hinge on high-resource commitment by targeted organizations, but instead on carefully addressing the temporal and cross-scale dynamics of activist-organization interactions within the digital panarchy.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了组织如何应对Black Lives Matter活动人士在社交媒体上表达的强烈社会不满，提出了数字泛系理论框架，发现有效应对不在于资源投入多少，而在于精准把握活动者-组织互动的时空动态。
AI.research_question: 组织如何成功或失败地应对社交媒体上针对他们的强烈社会不满？
AI.motivation: 填补数字行动主义和新兴技术研究领域的空白，理解组织在社交媒体时代如何应对社会不满
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字泛系理论（digital panarchy）- 多尺度景观中活动者和组织周期性互动的理论框架
AI.method: 定性和定量数据分析活动者与目标组织之间的互动，归纳性构建过程模型
AI.findings: 有效应对不依赖于高资源投入，而在于精准处理活动者-组织互动中的时间和跨尺度动态
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字泛系理论框架，拓展了数字行动主义和组织响应理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供在社交媒体时代有效应对社会不满的实践指导，强调时空动态管理而非单纯资源投入

title: Public Persuasion with Endogenous Fact-Checking
affiliations: and The National Research University

detail.title: Public Persuasion with Endogenous Fact-Checking
detail.abstract: We study public persuasion when a sender faces a mass audience that can verify the state at heterogeneous costs. The sender commits ex ante to a public information policy but must satisfy an ex post truthfulness constraint on verifiable content (EPIC). Receivers verify selectively, generating a verifying mass λ(µ; F) that depends on the public posterior µ. This yields an indirect value v(µ; F) and a concavification problem under implementability. Our main result is a reverse comparative static: when verification becomes cheaper (an FOSD improvement in F), v becomes more concave and the optimal public signal is strictly less informative (Blackwell). Intuitively, greater verifiability makes extreme claims invite scrutiny, so the sender optimally coarsens information-"confusion as strategy." We extend the model to two ex post instruments: falsification (continuous manipulation) and violence (a fixed-cost discrete tool), and characterize threshold substitutions from persuasion to manipulation and repression. The framework speaks to propaganda under improving fact-checking.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当发送者面对具有异质验证成本的受众时的公共说服问题。发送者事前承诺公共信息策略，但必须满足事后真实性约束。受众选择性验证形成验证规模，产生间接价值函数。主要发现是逆向比较静态：验证成本降低时，最优公共信号反而变得不那么信息丰富（更模糊）。模型扩展到伪造和暴力两种事后工具，揭示了从说服到操纵和压制的阈值替代。
AI.research_question: 当受众具有异质验证成本时，发送者如何设计最优公共信息策略？验证成本变化如何影响最优信息精确度？
AI.motivation: 研究在事实核查技术不断改进的背景下，宣传者如何调整信息策略。现实中受众验证成本存在差异，且验证技术日益普及，这影响了公共说服的动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯说服理论、验证成本异质性模型、事后真实性约束(EPIC)、Blackwell信息排序、比较静态分析
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建发送者-受众博弈框架，定义验证质量函数λ(µ; F)和间接价值函数v(µ; F)，求解concavification问题，进行FOSD比较静态分析
AI.findings: 主要结果：验证成本降低（FOSD改进）时，v函数变得更凹，最优公共信号严格变得更不信息丰富（Blackwell排序）。极端主张更容易引发核查，因此发送者最优策略是模糊信息-"混淆作为策略"
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了具有异质验证成本的公共说服理论框架；2) 发现了逆向比较静态关系；3) 提出了"混淆作为策略"的新见解；4) 扩展模型到多种事后工具
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解宣传策略在事实核查时代的变化提供理论解释，揭示了技术进步如何导致信息环境反而变得更加模糊的现象

detail.abstract: Introduction: The workplace encompasses structural and personal tensions related to both reproduction and non reproduction, as well as ambiguity and ambivalence permeate policies, practices, and social interactions. The aim of this study was to explore and record participants’ diverse fertility journeys and the e ect of work on their preconception/infertility experience. . Method: The concept of “reproductive capital” emerged from a latent thematic analysis of semi structured bionarrative interviews with people ( women and men)andtheiraccountsofhowtheworkplacea ectedtheirreproductive journeys. Results: The workplace was an alienating space for people accessing Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) treatment, who were subjected to scrutiny and judgment. The challenges faced by individuals included matters surrounding disclosure and subsequent consequences, desired/expected support, and what wasreceived. Someparticipants challenged the pronatalist policy status quo and sought change to make the workplace more inclusive. Participants’ accounts highlighted numerous situations in which reproductive capital was present. Discussion: Contextualizing theory through empirical data allows for a broader understanding of how socioeconomic, sociocultural, norms, and values influence individual and organizational behavior. This article critically examines the concept of “reproductive capital” and its interaction with other forms of capital: aging, biological, cultural, economic, social, and symbolic.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过半结构化生命叙事访谈，探讨工作场所对生育旅程的影响，提出了'生育资本'概念，分析了工作场所对接受辅助生殖技术治疗人员的异化作用及其与其他资本形式的互动。
AI.research_question: 工作场所如何影响人们的生育旅程和辅助生殖技术治疗体验？
AI.motivation: 工作场所中存在与生育和非生育相关的结构性及个人张力，政策、实践和社会互动中存在模糊性和矛盾性，需要探索工作对生育前/不孕经历的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生育资本理论，及其与老龄化资本、生物资本、文化资本、经济资本、社会资本和象征资本的互动关系。
AI.method: 采用潜在主题分析法对半结构化生命叙事访谈数据进行分析，访谈对象包括经历生育旅程的男女参与者。
AI.findings: 工作场所对接受ART治疗的人员而言是异化空间，他们面临审查和评判；挑战包括披露问题及后果、期望支持与实际获得支持的差距；部分参与者挑战生育主义政策现状，推动工作场所更具包容性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并发展了'生育资本'概念框架，丰富了资本理论在生育研究领域的应用，为理解社会经济、社会文化规范和价值观如何影响个体和组织行为提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织制定更具包容性的生育政策提供实证依据，帮助工作场所更好地支持员工的生育需求，促进工作环境对生育旅程的包容性改善。

title: Germs in the Family: The Short- and Long-Term Consequences of Intra-Household Disease Spread
affiliations: University of Copenhagen, Stanford University, Stanford University and Northwestern University

detail.title: Germs in the Family: The Short- and Long-Term Consequences of Intra-Household Disease Spread

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Preschool-aged children get sick frequently and spread disease to other family members. Despite the universality of this experience, there is limited causal evidence on the magnitudes and consequences of these externalities, especially for infant siblings with developing immune systems and brains. We use Danish administrative data to document that, before age one, younger siblings have 2-3 times higher hospitalization rates for respiratory conditions than older siblings. We combine birth order and within-municipality variation in respiratory disease prevalence among young children, and find lasting differential impacts of early-life respiratory disease exposure on younger siblings' earnings, educational attainment, chronic respiratory health and mental health-related outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文使用丹麦行政数据发现，学前儿童患病会通过呼吸道疾病传播对婴儿兄弟姐妹产生显著的负外部性，导致婴儿住院率增加2-3倍，并对收入、教育、慢性呼吸道健康和心理健康产生持久影响。
AI.research_question: 学前儿童患病对婴儿兄弟姐妹的健康和发展结果产生何种外部性影响？
AI.motivation: 学前儿童经常生病并将疾病传播给其他家庭成员，但关于这种外部性的大小和后果，特别是对免疫系统和大脑正在发育的婴儿兄弟姐妹的影响，缺乏因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于流行病传播理论和早期生命暴露对长期发展影响的理论框架，研究家庭内部疾病传播的外部性效应。
AI.method: 使用丹麦行政数据，结合出生顺序和市内幼儿呼吸道疾病患病率的变化，进行因果推断分析。
AI.findings: 一岁以下的年幼兄弟姐妹呼吸道疾病住院率比年长兄弟姐妹高2-3倍；早期生命呼吸道疾病暴露对年幼兄弟姐妹的收入、教育成就、慢性呼吸道健康和心理健康相关结果产生持久差异影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了学前儿童疾病传播对婴儿兄弟姐妹外部性影响的因果证据，丰富了家庭内部疾病传播和早期生命暴露的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策制定提供了重要依据，强调了保护婴儿免受年长兄弟姐妹疾病传播的重要性，对家庭健康管理和儿童保护政策具有实践指导意义。

title: Decoding Currency Dynamics: A Multiscale Machine Learning Approach Integrating Economic Indicators, ESG, and Investor Sentiment
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Ranchi

detail.title: Decoding Currency Dynamics: A Multiscale Machine Learning Approach Integrating Economic Indicators, ESG, and Investor Sentiment

publicationDetails.detailsText: Investment Management and Financial Innovations, volume 22, issue 3, 2025[10.21511/imfi.22(3).2025.03]

detail.abstract: The foreign exchange market, characterized by high volatility and economic significance, requires accurate predictive models. This study investigates the application of the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT), enhanced with Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN), for forecasting major foreign exchange (forex) currency pairs: USD/EUR, USD/JPY, USD/CNY, USD/ AUD, and USD/INR. The proposed framework integrates a wide range of economic indicators, which include interest rate differentials, GDP growth, and trade balances, alongside investor sentiment derived from Twitter and ESG-related news sentiment. By addressing the non-linear, multiscale nature of forex time series, the CEEMDANTFT model facilitates improved signal decomposition and interpretability. Empirical results indicate that the model demonstrates competitive performance across all five currency pairs, with the USD/EUR pair exhibiting the highest predictive accuracy. Other pairs, exhibiting good predictive accuracy, include USD/JPY and USD/CNY, underscoring the model’s adaptability to varying economic contexts. Performance is assessed using multiple error metrics, and the model is benchmarked against standard neural network approaches (MLP, RNN, LSTM, CNN). Variable importance analysis highlights the dynamic influence of interest rates, investor sentiment, and ESG factors across different market regimes. This study provides empirical evidence that including ESG and investor sentiment can improve the accuracy of currency forecasting models. This study provides guidance and a framework for informed decision-making for traders, analysts, and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合CEEMDAN和TFT的混合模型，用于预测主要外汇货币对。该模型整合了经济指标、投资者情绪和ESG新闻情绪，在五个货币对上都表现出竞争优势，其中USD/EUR预测精度最高。
AI.research_question: 如何利用CEEMDAN增强的Temporal Fusion Transformer模型来准确预测主要外汇货币对的汇率走势？
AI.motivation: 外汇市场具有高波动性和经济重要性，需要准确的预测模型。传统模型难以处理外汇时间序列的非线性和多尺度特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间序列分解理论（CEEMDAN）和深度学习时序预测理论（Temporal Fusion Transformer），结合行为金融学中的投资者情绪理论。
AI.method: 采用CEEMDAN-TFT混合模型，整合利率差异、GDP增长、贸易平衡等经济指标，以及Twitter投资者情绪和ESG新闻情绪数据。使用多种误差指标评估性能，并与标准神经网络方法（MLP、RNN、LSTM、CNN）进行基准比较。
AI.findings: 模型在所有五个货币对（USD/EUR、USD/JPY、USD/CNY、USD/AUD、USD/INR）上都表现出竞争优势，其中USD/EUR预测精度最高。变量重要性分析显示利率、投资者情绪和ESG因素在不同市场状态下具有动态影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了将ESG因素和投资者情绪纳入汇率预测模型的理论价值，为外汇预测提供了新的理论框架和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易员、分析师和政策制定者提供了决策指导框架，证明了包含ESG和投资者情绪可以提高货币预测模型的准确性。

title: Make Your Chatbot Price Like You Do: Identify and Customize Distributional Preferences of Large Language Models in Supply Chains
affiliations: Syracuse University - Whitman School of Management and Case Western Reserve University - Weatherhead School of Management

detail.title: Make Your Chatbot Price Like You Do: Identify and Customize Distributional Preferences of Large Language Models in Supply Chains
detail.abstract: Companies increasingly use large language model (LLM) agents for decision-making in various business processes, including supply chain procurement. How an LLM agent sets the price in a supply chain transaction, however, depends on its hidden traits, such as its self-interest level and preferences between achieving high efficiency or high fairness. Our paper examines these embedded distributional preferences of GPT-4o, Llama-4 Maverick, and the reasoning model GPT-o3 in a supply chain. We show that the type of decisions an LLM makes plays a significant role in shaping its distributional preferences. While a simple persona change from human to supplier or buyer reduces all LLMs' self-interest level, making pricing decisions as a firm increases it. Descriptions of supply chain relationships can customize all LLMs' distributional preferences, but to different extents. GPT-4o and Llama-4 have a strong "personality", with GPT-4o making the most balanced decisions and Llama-4 the most selfish. GPT-o3, on the other hand, is the most customizable and may resemble GPT-4o or Llama-4. We find that while concrete descriptions lead to similar and intuitive changes in all LLMs, generic descriptions such as "good relationship" lead to diverging results for GPT and Llama LLMs, making the former more fairness-minded and the latter more efficiency-driven. For a firm, the same relationship description applied to the same LLM may lead to opposite profit share outcomes depending on whether it is more or less financially constrained than its counterparty. Our research provides guidance on the characterization and design of LLM tools in supply chains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了GPT-4o、Llama-4和GPT-o3等大语言模型在供应链采购决策中的分配偏好，发现决策类型、人设设置和关系描述都会影响模型的自我利益水平和效率与公平偏好。GPT-4o做出最均衡决策，Llama-4最自私，GPT-o3则最容易定制。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型在供应链交易中的分配偏好如何受决策类型、人设设置和关系描述的影响？
AI.motivation: 企业越来越多地使用LLM模型进行供应链等商业决策，但模型的隐藏特质（如自我利益水平、效率与公平偏好）影响其定价决策，需要研究这些偏好如何形成和变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分配偏好理论（Distributional Preferences Theory），涉及自我利益、效率与公平的权衡，以及人设对模型行为的影响。
AI.method: 在供应链场景中测试GPT-4o、Llama-4 Maverick和GPT-o3模型，通过改变决策类型（个人/供应商/买方）、人设设置和关系描述，观察模型分配偏好的变化。
AI.findings:
1）从个人变为供应商/买方降低所有LLM的自我利益水平，但作为企业做定价决策会增加自我利益水平
2）GPT-4o做出最均衡决策，Llama-4最自私，GPT-o3最容易定制
3）具体描述导致所有LLM相似变化，但通用描述（如"良好关系"）使GPT更偏向公平而Llama更偏向效率
4）同一关系描述对财务约束不同的企业可能产生相反利润分配结果
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了LLM在供应链中分配偏好的系统性研究，扩展了分配偏好理论在AI决策中的应用，揭示了不同LLM的"个性"特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业选择和设计LLM工具提供指南，帮助企业根据具体需求（如需要均衡、自私或可定制性）选择合适的LLM，并通过精准的关系描述来调整模型行为。

title: Africa and Complexity: Turns and Misses
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: Africa and Complexity: Turns and Misses
detail.abstract: Africa is the deepest laboratory of emergence. Its states are young, its markets are young, its societies strained by post-independence turmoil. The commercialisation of politics has strained the institution of ubuntu. Perturbations arrive daily-droughts, pandemics, political turns. Complexity is not academic here. It is lived. Yet theory was codified elsewhere, in Santa Fe and Vienna, in the scaling laws of biology and cities. This essay reads two trails together. One trail is mathematics and physics-from zero to entropy, from symmetry to scaling, from operators to networks. The other is Africa's journey-independence, turmoil, adjustment, Millennium wave, Covid, climate. Set side by side, they reveal turns taken and turns missed. The missed turn of resilience, the vanished lessons of Covid, the present frontier of climate. The argument is simple. Complexity must be layered. Observatories must be built. Epistemic sovereignty must be claimed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将复杂性科学与非洲发展历程并置分析，揭示了非洲作为复杂性实验室的独特价值，提出了构建分层复杂性理论、建立观测站和争取认知主权的理论框架。

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel method for identifying fiscal austerity episodes using large language models (LLMs). We provide evidence on the correspondence between our LLM-based austerity episodes and those identified by IMF staff in studies like Adler et al. (2024).

title: Exchangeability as the Exact Condition for Shapley Symmetry

detail.title: Exchangeability as the Exact Condition for Shapley Symmetry
detail.abstract: We study the Shapley value under random coalition participation, where a probability distribution selects coalitions. We define the Participation Shapley as the ex-ante rule assigning each player their expected Shapley payoff. We show that symmetry holds if and only if the distribution is exchangeable, depending only on coalition size. Further, exchangeability with classical axioms does not yield uniqueness. To resolve this, we introduce participation consistency, requiring allocations to commute with random participation, which uniquely characterizes the Participation Shapley.

detail.abstract: We conduct an online experiment to study how the unfairness of chances leading to wage inequality affects labor supply decisions. We find that, at a given wage, disadvantageous wage inequality reduces labor supply, but whether this inequality stems from fair or unfair chances does not matter. That is, a procedure with fair chances does not compensate for wage inequality. Our results stand in stark contrast to prior empirical evidence showing that individuals care about fair chances when making equity judgments.

detail.title: How Do Caseworkers Affect Job Search Outcomes?

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how caseworkers influence job finding rates and job quality. To rule out selection effects, I exploit that caseworkers are assigned based on the jobseekers' month of birth in some offices of the Austrian public employment service. Combining administrative data on caseworkers and jobseekers, I compute value-added measures for multiple jobseeker outcomes. A one-standard-deviation increase in caseworker performance corresponds to six additional days of employment in the first year and two percent higher earnings. For older workers and workers of foreign nationality, I observe the largest differences in caseworker performance. Employment and earnings effects are positively correlated, suggesting that faster job finding does not come at the expense of job quality. Analyzing differences in caseworker strategies, I find that caseworkers who refer more vacancies to jobseekers achieve higher employment rates, and those who refer better-paying jobs also achieve higher earnings. In contrast, frequent use of training programs or benefit sanctions is associated with worse job search outcomes.

title: Nature Dependence, Economic Value, and Extinction Risk: Evidence from Biotech Innovations
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh - Katz Graduate School of Business,  and Rotterdam School of Management, Erasmus University

detail.title: Nature Dependence, Economic Value, and Extinction Risk: Evidence from Biotech Innovations
detail.abstract: This paper examines how nature dependence translates into economic value in the context of biotech innovations. We identify biotech patents as those involving the application of science to living organisms, and document that biotech patenting activities span across industries. Our most conservative estimate indicates that biotech patents are $639,000 more valuable than other granted patents, which is also reflected in firm level valuation and cash flow metrics. Exploiting a shock to the recognition of extinction risk of species in a patent, we show that constrained firms have lower valuation, cash flows, and capital expenditures. Overall, our results suggest that while nature dependence via biotechnology is valuable, the recognition of extinction risk can have significant implications for firm value.

title: Where Did It All Go Wrong for Russia in the 21st Century?
affiliations: SUNY at Binghamton, Department of Economics

detail.title: Where Did It All Go Wrong for Russia in the 21st Century?
detail.abstract: This paper uses the synthetic control method to predict how Russia could have developed under different scenarios in the 21st century. I construct the counterfactual for Russia starting in 2008, when Vladimir Putin's first tenure as president ended; starting in 2012, when Putin became president again; and starting in 2014, when Russia annexed Crimea and the Donbas War began. I find that Russia's GDP per capita growth path did not change after the presidential changes of 2008 or 2012; however, after the annexation of Crimea and the start of the Donbas War, the actual GDP per capita lagged behind the counterfactual one, with the gap between them reaching about 20% by 2019. * I thank the editor and two anonymous referees for their useful comments. I am grateful to Peter Dreuw for sharing his code for Dreuw (2023) with me.

title: Efficient Inference via Multi-Tier Routing of Large Language Model Queries
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Efficient Inference via Multi-Tier Routing of Large Language Model Queries
detail.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) deliver strong performance across domains but remain prohibitively expensive to run at scale. Current practice routes all queries, trivial or complex, through the same high-capacity model, leading to significant inefficiency. We introduce a lightweight multi-tier inference framework that adaptively selects among smaller, faster models and larger, more capable ones. Our method incorporates mechanisms to assess when escalation is warranted, allowing the system to retain accuracy while substantially reducing cost. We evaluate this framework on GSM8K (math reasoning), MMLU (general knowledge), and long-context summarization tasks using commercially available LLMs. Across workloads, the approach achieves up to 85% cost reduction on short queries and 30–60% savings on mixed datasets, while maintaining parity in accuracy with the strongest baseline. Latency overhead is modest and additional evaluation steps contribute less than 5% of overall cost. These results demonstrate that significant efficiency gains are achievable today without retraining or custom infrastructure, suggesting a practical pathway to more sustainable and accessible LLM deployment.

title: Who Gains from Agglomeration? The Wage, Productivity, and Cost Effects of Transport Improvements on Firms and Workers

detail.title: Who Gains from Agglomeration? The Wage, Productivity, and Cost Effects of Transport Improvements on Firms and Workers

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the impact of transport-induced agglomeration on workers' earnings, as well as the productivity and costs of establishments, in the capital region of Finland using comprehensive individual- and establishment-level registry data. To our knowledge, we are the first to jointly examine firm- and worker-level effects of agglomeration. We find that improved workplace-to-workplace accessibility increases employees annual earnings, particularly among workers in smaller firms. However, we find no statistically significant effects on value added or labour costs per worker at the establishment level. We propose two potential explanations for this discrepancy: (1) differences in the composition of workers between the worker- and establishment-level analyses due to, for example, new hires, and (2) rising costs associated with increased agglomeration. Further analysis reveals that enhanced accessibility leads to higher establishment employment and increased operating expenses, such as rents. Taken together, these findings suggest that the benefits of agglomeration are primarily shared between workers and property owners.

title: News reporting on travel restrictions between Canada and the US during the COVID-19 pandemic: An equity-based analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Simon Fraser University, Western Washington University and Western Washington University

detail.title: News reporting on travel restrictions between Canada and the US during the COVID-19 pandemic: An equity-based analysis
detail.abstract: The worldwide use of travel restrictions during the COVID-19 pandemic was unprecedented. There remains need for fuller understanding of how to apply travel measures for public benefit, while taking account social and economic impacts, particularly on equity-deserving populations. This paper analyses text-based online news coverage of restrictions on travel between Canada and the United States between March 2020 and May 2023 to ask whether and how different inequities relevant to travel restrictions were presented in the media. It aims to deepen understanding of how travel measures might have contributed to inequities and analyse how experiences of these inequities were presented. A multilevel framework analysis, based on health equity and justice conceptual frameworks, is applied to 41articles from Canada and the US. Results reveal that certain inequities (those experienced by older adults, caregivers, etc.) were more often described in news coverage than others (i.e. racialized populations), with many key equity deserving groups not mentioned at all (i.e. people with disabilities). News reports depict travel restrictions causing disproportionate economic and social harms on low-income residents, tourism-dependent regions and cross-border communities, including Indigenous communities. Public concerns with what were perceived to be unsystematic and unpredictable policy implementation, or a lack of compassion and discretionary powers of border officials, were underscored. This analysis identifies how news reports shed light and frame certain inequities, for some individuals and populations, arising from Canada-U.S. travel restrictions. It highlights the need to amplify equity within future responses to global public health emergencies, but also key gaps in knowledge.

title: Antidepressant Treatment in Childhood
affiliations: IZA Institute of Labor Economics, University of Copenhagen and Rockwool Foundation Research Unit

detail.title: Antidepressant Treatment in Childhood

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Mental illnesses emerge in childhood, making early intervention important. However, antidepressant treatment rates remain low following a controversial FDA warning. We provide some of the first evidence of impacts of antidepressant treatment in childhood on objectively measured mental health indicators and economic outcomes over time, and the first attempt to investigate under- vs overtreatment. Treatment improves Math scores in high school, post-compulsory education and adult employment and earnings, reducing welfare dependence. It reduces suicidality and hospital visits. Low-SES children benefit more. Policy simulations in a marginal treatment effects framework suggest under-treatment, highlighting that expanding treatment can reduce inequality.

AI.tldr: 该研究提供了儿童抗抑郁药物治疗对长期心理健康和经济影响的首次证据，发现治疗能改善数学成绩、教育程度、就业和收入，减少福利依赖和自杀风险，低收入儿童获益更多，政策模拟显示存在治疗不足问题。
AI.research_question: 儿童抗抑郁药物治疗对长期心理健康指标和经济结果有何影响？是否存在治疗不足或过度治疗的问题？
AI.motivation: 精神疾病在童年时期出现，早期干预很重要，但FDA警告后抗抑郁药物治疗率仍然很低，需要提供治疗效果的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于边际处理效应框架的政策模拟分析，评估抗抑郁药物治疗的长期影响和最优治疗水平。
AI.method: 使用客观测量的心理健康指标和经济结果数据，分析儿童抗抑郁药物治疗的长期影响，采用边际处理效应框架进行政策模拟。
AI.findings: 治疗改善高中数学成绩、后义务教育程度、成人就业和收入，减少福利依赖；降低自杀风险和医院就诊；低收入儿童获益更多。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了儿童抗抑郁药物治疗对长期结果的实证证据，建立了治疗不足的理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策模拟显示存在治疗不足问题，扩大治疗可以减少不平等，为儿童心理健康政策提供实证依据。

title: The Labour Market Impact of the COVID-19 Pandemic on Individuals with Disabilities: The Case of Ireland
affiliations: Economic and Social Research Institute, Ireland and Trinity College (Dublin)

detail.title: The Labour Market Impact of the COVID-19 Pandemic on Individuals with Disabilities: The Case of Ireland

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The COVID-19 health pandemic had a profound impact on labour markets worldwide, disproportionately affecting subgroups of the population, including individuals with disabilities. Despite extensive research on the broader impacts of the pandemic, there remains a notable gap in the literature concerning the labour market impact of COVID-19 on people with disabilities. This paper attempts to fill this gap for Ireland by examining the impact of the pandemic on disabled peoples unemployment status. The paper finds that individuals with disabilities were 2.7 percentage points more likely to be unemployed during the pandemic compared to those without disabilities. Even in 2023, people with disabilities remained more likely to be unemployed. However, our year interaction models revealed that the impact of disabilities on unemployment risk remained largely stable during and after the pandemic.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了COVID-19疫情对爱尔兰残疾人失业状况的影响，发现残疾人在疫情期间失业率比非残疾人高2.7个百分点，且这种影响在2023年仍然存在，但残疾对失业风险的影响在疫情前后保持相对稳定。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情对爱尔兰残疾人失业状况的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量关于疫情对劳动力市场影响的研究，但关于疫情对残疾人就业影响的文献存在明显空白，特别是在爱尔兰背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场歧视理论、健康经济学和危机对弱势群体影响的现有理论框架
AI.method: 使用年份交互模型分析疫情前后残疾人失业状况的对比数据
AI.findings: 1) 残疾人在疫情期间失业可能性比非残疾人高2.7个百分点；2) 到2023年，残疾人仍然更可能失业；3) 残疾对失业风险的影响在疫情前后保持稳定
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了疫情对特定弱势群体（残疾人）劳动力市场影响的文献空白，为危机时期弱势群体保护政策提供理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 为爱尔兰和其他国家制定针对残疾人的就业支持政策和危机应对措施提供实证依据，强调需要长期关注残疾人就业问题

title: Unconventional Monetary Policy Spillovers and the (In)convenience of Treasuries
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill

detail.title: Unconventional Monetary Policy Spillovers and the (In)convenience of Treasuries

publicationDetails.detailsText: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Working Paper No. RWP 25-10
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using high frequency data, we find that spillovers to the U.S. yield curve from the European Central Bank increased following the Global Financial Crisis, and strengthened when the U.S. normalized policy out of sync with other advanced economies. These spillovers were amplified by a contemporaneous waning in the "convenience" of Treasuries. This provides evidence for a portfolio balance channel of transmission that is time-varying based on the non-pecuniary characteristics of Treasuries. We rationalize these facts using a two-country model of preferred habitat investors, where time-varying price-elasticity of demand for Treasuries gives rise to time-varying spillovers.

AI.tldr: 通过高频数据分析，研究发现欧洲中央银行对美国收益率曲线的外溢效应在2008年金融危机后增强，并在美国与其他先进经济体政策不同步时更为显著。这种时变外溢效应由于美债的非金融特性（便利性）的消退而强化，为投资组合平衡传导渠道提供了证据。
AI.research_question: 欧洲中央银行政策对美国收益率曲线的外溢效应如何随时间变化？以及这种时变性的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解国际金融市场间的跨境传导机制，尤其是在全球金融危机后中央银行政策分化的背景下，详细探索外溢效应的时间变异性和其驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合平衡渠道理论，特别是基于偏好溯汇投资者的两国模型，关注国债的非金融特性（如便利性）对传导机制的影响。
AI.method: 高频数据分析，构建两国模型来理论化实证结果，重点考察美国国债需求价格弹性的时间变化如何导致外溢效应的时间变异性。
AI.findings:
1）ECB对美国收益率曲线的外溢效应在金融危机后显著增强
2）美国与其他先进经济体政策不同步时外溢效应更强
3）美债便利性的消退强化了这种外溢效应
4）投资组合平衡渠道是重要的传导机制
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了投资组合平衡渠道时间变异性的实证证据，扩展了国际金融传导理论，将国债非金融特性与跨境外溢效应联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于跨境政策协调重要性的实证支撑，帮助投资者理解国际政策分化时期的市场风险。

title: Was the Post-Lockdown Inflation Surge Mainly Supply Driven?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis and University of California Berkeley

detail.title: Was the Post-Lockdown Inflation Surge Mainly Supply Driven?
detail.abstract: This paper studies PCE price and quantity changes at the disaggregate level using a generalization of Shapiro's (2024) inflation decomposition method, adapted to account for inflation dynamics. We apply the decomposition to analyze drivers of high inflation in PCE core goods and services between late 2020 and 2022. We benchmark the technique using a classic supply disruption, the 1973 oil embargo and find that 75 percent of non-trend inflation immediately following the embargo was supply-push.  In contrast, 33 percent of non-trend inflation was supply-push following the pandemic lockdown. Restricting attention to categories with market-based prices, this falls to 26 percent.

AI.tldr: 本文使用改进的Shapiro通胀分解方法，分析了2020-2022年PCE核心商品和服务的高通胀驱动因素，并与1973年石油禁运进行对比，发现疫情封锁后的供给推动通胀占比显著低于石油危机时期
AI.research_question: 疫情后高通胀的主要驱动因素是什么？供给推动和需求拉动各自贡献了多少？
AI.motivation: 理解近期高通胀的结构性原因，为政策制定提供依据，并与历史供给冲击事件进行对比分析
AI.theoretical_framework: Shapiro通胀分解方法的推广，考虑通胀动态的改进模型，供给-需求分析框架
AI.method: 改进的Shapiro通胀分解技术，应用于PCE核心商品和服务的细分数据，与1973年石油禁运案例进行基准对比
AI.findings: 1973年石油禁运后75%的非趋势通胀来自供给推动，而疫情封锁后仅有33%来自供给推动（使用市场定价类别时降至26%）
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了考虑通胀动态的改进分解方法，提供了供给冲击通胀效应的量化分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策制定提供实证依据，帮助区分不同时期通胀的驱动机制，支持针对性政策应对

title: הקונגרס האזרחי: פתרון מוסדי למשברי ניגוד עניינים בין הרשויות בישראל Civil Congress: An Institutional Framework for Resolving Conflicts of Interest Among Israel's Governing Authorities

detail.title: הקונגרס האזרחי: פתרון מוסדי למשברי ניגוד עניינים בין הרשויות בישראל Civil Congress: An Institutional Framework for Resolving Conflicts of Interest Among Israel's Governing Authorities
