detail.abstract:
תקציר בעברית: מדינת ישראל שרויה במשבר עמוק, ששורשיו אינם רק בכשלים מבניים אלא בשחיקה שיטתית של נורמות וכללים דמוקרטיים בלתי כתובים. המאמר טוען כי עיקר השחיקה נוצר בעקבות התנהלות הרשויות והמערכת הפוליטית, בהיות הרשויות המקור לשחיקה זו, אינן מסוגלות לרפא את עצמן. בעוד שפתרונות קדמיים מבניים 'מלמעלה', דוגמת כינון בית מחוקקים נוסף, נותרים בלתי ישימים במציאות הפוליטית המקוטבת, ופתרונות אחרים הנדונים בשיח הציבורי, כמו רפורמות משפטיות, מטפלות בסימפטומים בלבד ולא במחלה עצמה. מתוך אבחנה זו, המאמר מציע תזה רדיקלית: המשבר החוקתי הנוכחי אינו רק משבר, אלא גם הזדמנות טראגית. הוא מהווה הזדמנות משום שבכך שהוא שם מראה מול פני החברה הישראלית, הוא חושף בעוצמה את אי-ההתאמה היסודית בין המודל המשטרי הקיים לבין החברה הישראלית הייחודית על כל גווניה, ובכך מכוון אותנו להתמודד עם שורש הבעיה

כמענה לכך, המאמר מציע מודל לכינון "קונגרס אזרחי" – המורכבת מאסיפה א-מפלגתית בבסיסה כמפקחת, ותשמש כ 'מצפן נורמטיבי' לאומה. גוף זה, שיורכב מאזרחים שייבחרו בהגרלה לכל מושב (סורטיציה) ויפעל תחת חסותו הממלכתית של נשיא המדינה, לא יעסוק בחקיקה. תפקידו יהיה להגדיר בזמן אמת, באמצעות דמוקרטיה דיונית (דליברטיבית), מהי הנורמה הציבורית הראויה, ולסמן כל התנהלות שאינה מתקבלת מצד אנשי ציבור, ובכך להוות בלם אפקטיבי על הרשויות, לפתור ניגודי עניינים, ולשקם את אמון הציבור.

המאמר מציג מודל יישום "מלמטה למעלה" (Bottom-Up), בהשראת אסיפות אזרחים מוצלחות בעולם, ורואה בקונגרס לא יעד סופי, אלא בין אם צעד אד-הוק לפתרון המשבר החוקתי במדינה, ובין אם כשלב מקדים והכרחי שתכליתו לכונן מחדש את כללי המשחק הבלתי כתובים, למתוח את גבולות הגזרה של הרשויות, ולהכשיר את הקרקע לרפורמות חוקתיות עמוקות בעתיד.

English Abstract: The State of Israel is in a deep crisis, rooted not merely in structural flaws, but in the systematic erosion of unwritten democratic norms. This paper argues that the political system, being the source of this erosion, is incapable of healing itself. While "top-down" structural solutions, such as establishing an upper house of legislature, remain unfeasible, and other reforms only treat the symptoms, this paper proposes a radical thesis: the current constitutional crisis is not just a breakdown, but also a tragic opportunity, powerfully exposing the fundamental incompatibility between the existing governmental model and the diverse Israeli society.

In response, the paper proposes a model for establishing a “Civil Congress”—an apolitical, supervisory body to serve as a 'normative compass'. This body, composed of citizens selected by lot (sortition) and operating through deliberative democracy, would not legislate. Its role would be to define appropriate public norms in real-time, act as an effective check on the authorities, and work to restore public trust.

The paper presents a 'bottom-up' implementation model inspired by successful citizens' assemblies worldwide. The model has built-in flexibility: it can serve both as an ad-hoc solution to the immediate constitutional crisis and as a necessary preliminary stage aimed at re-establishing the rules of the game, defining the boundaries of governmental power, and preparing the ground for future constitutional reforms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以色列的深层危机源于不成文民主规范的系统性侵蚀，政治体系无法自我修复。作者建议建立'公民大会'作为规范性指南针，通过抽签选举公民组成审议性民主机构，实时定义公共规范，监督政府行为，恢复公众信任。
AI.research_question: 如何解决以色列政治体系中不成文民主规范的系统性侵蚀问题？
AI.motivation: 以色列正经历深刻的宪法危机，根源在于不成文民主规范的持续侵蚀，而现行政治体系无法自我修复，需要寻找新的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 审议民主理论、抽签民主（sortition）、公民大会模式、自下而上的治理改革理论
AI.method: 提出建立'公民大会'的理论模型，采用抽签方式选举公民代表，通过审议民主程序定义公共规范，作为监督政府的非立法性机构。
AI.findings: 现行自上而下的结构性改革不可行，需要建立自下而上的监督机制；公民大会可以作为有效的规范性指南针，解决权力机构间的利益冲突，恢复公众信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将宪法危机视为改革机遇的激进论点；发展了基于抽签和审议民主的公民监督机构理论模型；为不成文规范的制度化提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的'公民大会'实施方案；可作为临时危机解决方案或未来宪法改革的预备阶段；为以色列及其他类似政治体系的国家提供了可行的治理改革路径。

title: Ethos Ex Machina: Identity Without Expression in Compiled Syntax
affiliations: Universidad de la Republica

detail.title: Ethos Ex Machina: Identity Without Expression in Compiled Syntax
detail.abstract: This article demonstrates that authority effects in large language model outputs can be generated independently of thematic content or authorial identity. Building on Ethos Without Source and The Grammar of Objectivity, it introduces the concept of no expressive ethos, a credibility effect produced solely by syntactic configurations compiled through a regla compilada equivalent to a Type-0 generative system. The study identifies a minimal set of structural markers (symmetric coordination, measured negation, legitimate passives, calibrated modality, nominalizations, balance operators, and reference scaffolds) that simulate trustworthiness and impartiality even in content-neutral texts. Through corpus ablation and comparative analysis, it shows that readers systematically attribute expertise and neutrality to texts that satisfy these structural conditions, regardless of topical information. By formalizing this mechanism, the article reframes ethos as a syntactic phenomenon detached from content, intention, and external validation. It explains how LLM-produced drafts acquire legitimacy without verification and why institutions increasingly accept authority signals generated by structure alone. The findings extend the theory of syntactic power and consolidate the role of the regla compilada as the operative generator of credibility in post-referential discourse.

AI.tldr: 本文证明大语言模型输出中的权威效应可以独立于主题内容或作者身份产生，通过纯句法配置产生可信度效果，识别了模拟可信度和公正性的最小结构标记集，并解释了LLM生成文本如何仅通过结构获得合法性。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型输出中的权威效应是否可以在独立于主题内容和作者身份的情况下产生？纯句法配置如何生成可信度效果？
AI.motivation: 理解LLM生成文本如何获得可信度和权威性，即使在没有内容验证的情况下，解释为什么机构越来越接受仅通过结构产生的权威信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"无来源的品格"和"客观性语法"理论，引入"无表达品格"概念，使用类似于Type-0生成系统的regla compilada（编译规则）来形式化句法可信度机制。
AI.method: 通过语料库消融和比较分析，识别最小结构标记集（对称协调、测量否定、合法被动、校准情态、名词化、平衡算子和参考支架），并测试读者对这些结构的可信度归因。
AI.findings: 读者系统地将专业知识和中立性归因于满足这些结构条件的文本，无论主题信息如何；LLM生成的草稿可以在没有验证的情况下获得合法性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将品格重新定义为脱离内容、意图和外部验证的句法现象，扩展了句法权力理论，巩固了regla compilada在后指称话语中作为可信度操作生成器的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了为什么机构接受仅通过结构产生的权威信号，为理解LLM生成内容的可信度机制提供了实践洞见，有助于识别和评估自动化文本生成的可信度特征。

title: Compulsory Schooling and Long-Term Outcomes: Evidence from a Nationwide Education Reform in Mexico
affiliations: University of Sussex, Department of Economics

detail.title: Compulsory Schooling and Long-Term Outcomes: Evidence from a Nationwide Education Reform in Mexico
detail.abstract: This paper examines the long-term and intergenerational impacts of Mexico’s 1993 reform extending compulsory schooling from six to nine years. Exploiting the age-based discontinuity in exposure, the study implements a regression discontinuity and instrumental-variable strategy to estimate the causal effect of education. The reform increased schooling on average, with disproportionately large gains among Indigenous and rural populations. These educational improvements translated into lasting shifts in fertility, child mortality, employment, and internal migration. Intergenerationally, parental schooling gains raised secondary and upper-secondary enrolment among children. By following a single reform across demographic, labour-market, and intergenerational domains, the paper provides a life-course perspective on how expanded schooling reshapes life trajectories. The results highlight the role of compulsory schooling in reducing structural inequalities and demonstrate that, in the context of a large middle-income country, such reforms can generate sustained and intergenerational benefits beyond immediate educational attainment.

AI.tldr: 墨西哥1993年义务教育改革（从6年延长至9年）通过断点回归和工具变量方法分析，发现该改革显著提高了教育水平（特别是原住民和农村人口），带来了生育率下降、儿童死亡率降低、就业改善和内部迁移等长期影响，并在代际层面提升了子女的教育入学率。
AI.research_question: 墨西哥1993年义务教育改革（从6年延长至9年）对个人长期生活轨迹和代际影响的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究义务教育延长政策在中等收入大国背景下的长期和代际影响，评估此类教育改革在减少结构性不平等和重塑生命轨迹方面的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本理论、教育回报理论和代际流动理论，分析教育扩展对个人生命周期和代际传递的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用断点回归设计（RD）和工具变量（IV）策略，利用年龄暴露差异产生的自然实验条件来识别因果效应。
AI.findings: 改革平均提高了教育水平，原住民和农村人口获益最大；导致生育率下降、儿童死亡率降低、就业状况改善和内部迁移模式变化；父母教育提升促进了子女的中等和高中教育入学率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了教育改革的完整生命周期视角，揭示了义务教育扩展如何系统性重塑个人生活轨迹和代际流动模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了在中等收入国家背景下，义务教育改革能够产生持续的多代收益，为教育政策制定提供了实证依据，特别是在减少结构性不平等方面具有重要政策意义。

title: Heterogeneous Consumer Valuations of a Mild Climate
affiliations: University of California, Irvine - Department of Economics

detail.title: Heterogeneous Consumer Valuations of a Mild Climate
detail.abstract: This paper explores heterogeneous individual valuations of an important amenity, climate mildness. It does so by including interaction terms between the amenity and worker characteristics in a Rosen-Roback hedonic wage regression. The results show that, for workers of a given age, those with high or low education levels value a mild climate more than those with a moderate level of education. These findings, which contradict the view that only better-off individuals care about amenities, could reflect the lower burden in mild weather of the manual work done by the less educated. In addition, for any education level, workers in the 35-55 age range value a mild climate more than do young and old workers. In addition to presenting these novel empirical findings, the paper further contributes by presenting new analytics for the Rosen-Roback model in a setting with worker heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Rosen-Roback享乐工资回归模型，研究了不同教育水平和年龄段的工人对温和气候这一重要便利设施的异质性估值。研究发现，低教育和高教育水平的工人比中等教育水平的工人更重视温和气候，且35-55岁工人比年轻和年老工人更重视温和气候。
AI.research_question: 不同教育水平和年龄段的工人对温和气候这一便利设施的估值是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 探索个体对重要便利设施（气候温和度）的异质性估值，挑战只有富裕人群才关心便利设施的传统观点
AI.theoretical_framework: Rosen-Roback享乐工资模型，通过引入便利设施与工人特征的交互项来捕捉异质性估值
AI.method: 在Rosen-Roback享乐工资回归中包含气候温和度与工人特征（教育水平、年龄）的交互项
AI.findings: 1) 给定年龄下，高教育和低教育水平的工人比中等教育水平的工人更重视温和气候；2) 给定教育水平下，35-55岁工人比年轻和年老工人更重视温和气候
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在工人异质性情境下Rosen-Roback模型的新分析方法
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果挑战了只有富裕人群才关心便利设施的传统观点，可能反映了温和天气对低教育水平工人从事体力工作的负担减轻

title: Earnings Releases and Patterns in Information Asymmetry
affiliations: Temple University, University of Georgia - J.M. Tull School of Accounting and University of Georgia - Terry College of Business

detail.title: Earnings Releases and Patterns in Information Asymmetry
detail.abstract: We examine information asymmetry around earnings releases. While prior research finds asymmetry increases on Days [0, +1] and declines below non-announcement levels in Days [+2, +10], we show this pattern does not describe most earnings releases. In approximately 35% of firm-quarters, asymmetry decreases on Days [0, +1]. For approximately 65% of firm-quarters, asymmetry increases on Days [0, +1] but does not fully revert to below non-announcement levels in Days [+2, +10]. We identify factors contributing to these increases, including greater ownership by transient and quasi-indexer institutions and more disclosure at the earnings release. Moreover, asymmetry increases on Days [0, +1] have become more common, rising from under 40% of firm-quarters in the early 1990s to over 70% in recent years. Our findings revise the understanding of information asymmetry dynamics around earnings releases.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了盈余公告期间的信息不对称模式，发现传统认知（公告日不对称性增加，随后下降至低于非公告日水平）并不适用于大多数情况。约35%的公司季度中，公告日不对称性反而下降；约65%的情况下，公告日不对称性增加但不会完全恢复到低于非公告日水平。研究发现机构投资者持股和披露程度是重要影响因素，且这种不对称性增加的趋势在近年来显著上升。
AI.research_question: 盈余公告期间信息不对称的动态模式是什么？传统认知是否准确描述了大多数盈余公告的情况？
AI.motivation: 先前研究发现盈余公告期间信息不对称在公告日增加，随后下降至低于非公告日水平，但本文质疑这一模式是否适用于大多数实际情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论，探讨盈余公告对市场信息环境的影响，特别是机构投资者行为和披露实践的作用。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用公司季度数据，考察不同时间窗口（[0,+1]日和[+2,+10]日）的信息不对称变化模式。
AI.findings: 1) 约35%的公司季度中，公告日不对称性下降；2) 约65%的情况下，公告日不对称性增加但不会完全恢复；3) 机构投资者持股和披露程度是重要影响因素；4) 不对称性增加的趋势从1990年代初的40%上升至近年来的70%以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 修正了对盈余公告期间信息不对称动态的传统理解，提出了更细致的分类模式，丰富了信息不对称理论在盈余公告情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、监管机构和公司提供了关于盈余公告信息环境的新见解，有助于更好地理解市场反应和制定相应的投资与披露策略。

title: Political Views and College Choices in a Polarized America
affiliations: Miami University, Tulane University and Louisiana State University

detail.title: Political Views and College Choices in a Polarized America

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the role of students' political views in shaping college enrollment decisions in the United States. We hypothesize that students derive utility from attending institutions aligned with their political identities, which could reinforce demographic and regional disparities in educational attainment and reduce ideological diversity on campuses. Using four decades of survey data on college freshmen, we document increasing political polarization in colleges' student bodies, which is not fully explained by sorting along demographic, socioeconomic, or academic lines. To further explore these patterns, we conduct a series of survey-based choice experiments that quantify the value students place on political alignment relative to factors such as cost and proximity. We find that both liberal and conservative students prefer institutions with more like-minded peers and, especially, with fewer students from the opposite side of the political spectrum. The median student is willing to pay up to $2,617 (12.5%) more to attend a college where the share of students with opposing political views is 10 percentage points lower, suggesting that political identity plays a meaningful role in the college choice process.

AI.tldr: 美国大学生在择校时会考虑政治立场匹配度，自由派和保守派学生都偏好政治观点相似的院校，愿意为减少10%对立政治观点学生支付2617美元（12.5%学费溢价），这加剧了校园政治极化。
AI.research_question: 学生的政治观点如何影响美国大学入学决策？政治身份认同在择校过程中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 研究政治身份认同对高等教育选择的影响，探讨政治极化如何通过择校行为加剧校园意识形态单一化，并可能强化教育获得的地域和人口差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于身份效用理论，学生从政治立场匹配的院校获得效用；采用选择实验方法量化政治对齐的相对价值。
AI.method: 使用40年新生调查数据分析校园政治极化趋势，结合调查选择实验量化学生对政治对齐的支付意愿。
AI.findings: 校园政治极化加剧且不能完全由人口、社会经济或学术因素解释；学生普遍偏好政治观点相似的院校，特别回避对立政治观点学生；中位数学生愿为减少10%对立观点学生支付2617美元溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政治身份认同纳入高等教育选择理论框架，实证验证政治效用在学校选择中的重要性，拓展了身份经济学在教育领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校招生政策提供 insights，帮助理解校园多样性挑战；为政策制定者解决教育不平等和意识形态隔离问题提供实证依据。

title: Power And Competition in Energy Markets
affiliations: UIBS United International Business Schools

detail.title: Power And Competition in Energy Markets
detail.abstract: Individuals make interactions and exchanges behind a market which provides them with information and makes them take their separate decisions, coordinate and form coalitions and agreements that give them more power and advantages to maximize the benefits. In this paper, I will consider assignment markets where buyers and sellers play a double role as buyers and sellers and exchange two products separately and worth a benefit at the end of the game. I will study the core, the competitive equilibrium, and I will introduce market value, which I named the bargaining and collaboration value.

AI.tldr: 本文研究买卖双方双重角色的分配市场，分析核心、竞争均衡，并引入名为讨价还价与合作价值的市场价值概念
AI.research_question: 在买卖双方双重角色的分配市场中，如何分析市场均衡和价值分配机制？
AI.motivation: 传统市场模型往往将参与者单一归类为买方或卖方，但现实中个体经常同时扮演两种角色，需要新的理论框架来分析这种复杂交互
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、合作博弈理论、市场均衡理论、核心理论
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，通过构建分配市场模型，研究核心解、竞争均衡，并引入新的价值概念
AI.findings: 提出了买卖双方双重角色的市场模型，定义了讨价还价与合作价值，分析了在这种复杂市场结构下的均衡状态
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统市场理论，提出了适用于双重角色参与者的市场价值概念，丰富了合作博弈理论在复杂市场中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为现实世界中同时作为买卖方的市场参与者提供了理论指导，有助于理解复杂市场交互中的价值创造和分配机制

title: Green Goodwill and Effectiveness of Carbon Abatement Policies: Static and Dynamic Perspectives
affiliations: Guangzhou College of Technology and Business and Lancaster University - Lancaster University Management School, affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Green Goodwill and Effectiveness of Carbon Abatement Policies: Static and Dynamic Perspectives
detail.abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of carbon abatement policies in a Cournot duopoly framework, incorporating static and dynamic analysis. We evaluate four policy interventions— enhancing consumer green awareness, promoting corporate environmental responsibility, reducing carbon abatement costs, and increasing carbon tax rates—and their effects on firms' environmental, economic, and social performance. A static model reveals equilibrium outcomes driven by consumer preferences for firms' green goodwill, while a dynamic extension, incorporating bounded rationality, explores market stability. Our findings underscore the importance of balancing green innovation incentives with mechanisms to maintain stability, offering insights for effective and sustainable policy design in competitive markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究在古诺双寡头框架下评估四种碳减排政策的有效性，通过静态和动态分析探讨政策对企业环境、经济和社会绩效的影响，强调平衡绿色创新激励与市场稳定的重要性。
AI.research_question: 碳减排政策在竞争性市场中如何影响企业的环境、经济和社会绩效？不同政策干预措施的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 随着全球气候变化问题日益严峻，制定有效的碳减排政策成为重要议题。在竞争性市场环境中，政策设计需要平衡环境保护、企业经济效益和市场稳定性等多重目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 古诺双寡头竞争模型，结合消费者绿色偏好和企业绿色商誉理论，采用静态均衡分析和动态有界理性分析框架。
AI.method: 构建静态古诺双寡头模型分析均衡结果，建立动态扩展模型考察市场稳定性，评估四种政策干预措施的效果。
AI.findings: 静态模型显示均衡结果受消费者对企业绿色商誉偏好的驱动；动态分析表明需要平衡绿色创新激励与市场稳定机制；不同政策干预措施对企业三重绩效有差异化影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了古诺竞争模型在环境政策分析中的应用，提出了结合静态均衡和动态稳定性的综合分析框架，丰富了绿色创新与市场竞争的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供有效的碳减排政策设计建议，帮助企业理解政策环境下的战略选择，促进可持续竞争市场的发展。

title: Firm Ownership and Pollution
affiliations: , Uppsala University and University of Pennsylvania - Business & Public Policy Department

detail.title: Firm Ownership and Pollution
detail.abstract: We provide a theoretical micro foundation for how much pollution (negative externalities) a firm will internalize based on the ownership distribution of its shareholders. Small shareholders, compared to large ones, want the firm to spend more on avoiding pollution since they suffer less profit loss for the same environmental benefit. In particular, if a shareholder holds a share of 1/N, where N is the population in society, that shareholder's preferences align with a social planner's. Three theoretical predictions arise. First, small shareholders will systematically vote for a greener corporate profile. Second, firms with a smaller weighted-median shareholder will pollute less. Third, countries with concentrated corporate wealth holdings and/or more individualized firm ownership pollute more. This implies that standard models of externalities in environmental economics and macroeconomics containing representative agents are either internally inconsistent or not fully specified.

AI.tldr: 论文通过股东所有权分布理论解释了企业污染内部化程度，发现小股东比大股东更倾向于支持环保，因为他们在相同环境收益下承受的利润损失更小。
AI.research_question: 股东所有权分布如何影响企业污染内部化决策？
AI.motivation: 为环境污染负外部性的企业内部化提供微观理论基础，揭示不同规模股东在环保决策上的利益差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于股东所有权份额的环境偏好理论，提出当股东持有1/N份额时其偏好与社会规划者一致。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，通过数学推导建立股东规模与环保偏好之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1) 小股东系统性地投票支持更环保的企业形象；2) 加权中位数股东较小的企业污染更少；3) 公司财富集中和/或企业所有权更分散的国家污染更多。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了标准环境经济学和宏观经济学中代表性代理人模型的内在不一致性或不完全性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过调整所有权结构来促进企业环保行为的新视角，对环境保护政策具有重要启示。

title: AI Waiting Taxes-The Hidden Cost of Idle Time in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: AI Waiting Taxes-The Hidden Cost of Idle Time in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is widely promoted as a technology of speed, efficiency, and scale. From large language models that compose entire essays in seconds to image generators that produce artwork at unprecedented velocity, the prevailing narrative frames AI as an antidote to slowness. Yet beneath this promise lies a concealed cost: the waiting tax. Users often encounter latency in every stage of AI interaction—whether a few seconds of pause during sentence-by-sentence rendering, minutes of computational delay for image synthesis, or hours spent queuing for access to large-scale resources. These intervals appear trivial in isolation, but when multiplied across millions of tasks and users, they form a structural drag on productivity, cognition, and equity. This paper introduces the concept of AI Waiting Taxes (AWTs) as an overlooked dimension of the digital economy. We argue that waiting is not neutral downtime but a hidden levy on time, attention, and cognitive energy. To formalize this idea, we propose a multi-level conceptual framework that distinguishes four mechanisms—temporal, cognitive, behavioral, and societal—and situates them across three analytic dimensions: economic, psychological, and social. We also classify waiting into short-, mid-, and long-term horizons to capture its cumulative impact. To make the concept measurable, we sketch the AI Waiting Time Inefficiency (AWTI) Index, which normalizes waiting time, rework, and attentional fragmentation against non-AI baselines. The contribution of this study is conceptual and methodological. It does not yet present field data or empirical validation; rather, it names, theorizes, and sketches metrics for an invisible burden. By treating waiting as a form of temporal taxation, we highlight issues of distributive fairness and cognitive justice in the age of AI. This working paper therefore provides both a theoretical lens and a preliminary methodological tool to guide future research, corporate practice, and public policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI等待税(AI Waiting Taxes)的概念，指出AI技术虽然被宣传为快速高效，但实际上用户在各种AI交互环节中经历的等待时间构成了对时间、注意力和认知能量的隐性征税。
AI.research_question: AI技术使用中的等待时间如何构成一种隐性的时间税，以及对生产力、认知和公平性产生什么结构性影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI被广泛宣传为快速高效的技术，但用户在AI交互过程中普遍经历各种等待延迟，这些看似微不足道的等待时间在规模化后形成了重要的结构性负担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层级概念框架，区分四种机制（时间性、认知性、行为性、社会性）和三个分析维度（经济、心理、社会），并将等待分为短、中、长期三个时间维度。
AI.method: 概念性和方法论研究，提出了AI等待时间效率指数(AWTI Index)的概念框架，但尚未进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 等待不是中性的停机时间，而是对时间、注意力和认知能量的隐性征税，需要从分配公平和认知正义的角度来理解。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出了AI等待税的理论概念，建立了多层级分析框架，为理解AI技术的时间成本提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了初步的方法论工具(AWTI指数)，可指导未来研究、企业实践和公共政策制定，帮助识别和减轻AI等待带来的隐性成本。

title: Banks’ Regulatory Risk Tolerance
affiliations: Bank of Finland, European Central Bank (ECB) and Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Monetary and Economic Department

detail.title: Banks’ Regulatory Risk Tolerance

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 11/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In managing their capital, banks balance the risk of breaching regulatory requirements against the cost of maintaining and speedily restoring “management” buffers. Using 68 quarters of data on 17 US and 17 euro-area banks, we find systematic reductions in steady-state management buffer targets and attendant rises in regulatory risk tolerance (RRT) following the Great Financial Crisis (GFC). This phenomenon is particularly pronounced at banks with higher capital requirements post GFC. In parallel, banks facing more volatile management buffer shocks set higher management buffer targets, suggesting that RRT is a conscious choice. High-RRT banks tend to respond to a depletion of their management buffers by cutting lending, whereas low-RRT banks reduce the riskiness of their assets in other ways — thus highlighting real-economy effects of capital management strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2008年金融危机后欧美银行资本管理策略的变化，发现银行系统性降低了管理缓冲目标并提高了监管风险容忍度，特别是资本要求更高的银行。高监管风险容忍度银行倾向于通过削减贷款来应对缓冲耗尽，而低容忍度银行则通过其他方式降低资产风险。
AI.research_question: 金融危机后银行如何调整资本管理缓冲目标和监管风险容忍度，以及这些调整对实体经济的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解银行在平衡监管要求违反风险与维持管理缓冲成本之间的资本管理策略，特别是金融危机后的系统性变化及其经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行资本管理理论，研究银行在监管要求和管理缓冲之间的权衡决策，以及风险容忍度的概念框架。

title: Who Feels the Pinch? A Review of Credit Channel Responses to Economic Policy Uncertainty
affiliations: Western Sydney University

detail.title: Who Feels the Pinch? A Review of Credit Channel Responses to Economic Policy Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Economic policy uncertainty (EPU) has become a crucial factor in financial decision-making, particularly following repeated global economic shocks. Uncertainty influences banks' behaviour not only through defaults but also by raising lending rates and limiting loan availability. However, its impact on the credit supply channel-via repricing, reduced origination, and higher interest rates-remains insufficiently explored. This research investigates how economic policy uncertainty is transmitted through the credit channel to affect bank credit supply, loan growth, and loan repricing in both advanced and emerging economies. The review combines recent empirical findings, covering episodes such as the Global Financial Crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic. It demonstrates that increases in EPU consistently decrease credit supply, slow loan origination, and widen lending spreads as banks adjust for heightened default risk and liquidity issues. Quantitative data suggest that a onestandard-deviation rise in EPU results in a 2-3 percentage point decline in net loan growth, while also increasing loan spreads by 15-30 basis points. The effects are more pronounced during crises and among less-capitalised institutions. This study identifies two interconnected transmission mechanisms operating through the credit channel. First, uncertainty directly worsens banks' risk perceptions and funding conditions, leading to tighter credit standards and higher borrower costs. Second, this repricing dynamic ultimately feeds back into weaker loan demand and reduced credit availability. Emerging markets and smaller banks are more vulnerable to contraction risk, as differences in institutional strength, market structure, and policy frameworks influence this effect. The review underscores that incorporating uncertainty metrics into provisioning, strengthening countercyclical buffers, and improving transparency are vital for stabilising credit markets amid policy unpredictability.

detail.title: IPO Underpricing and Local Newspaper Closures
detail.abstract: IPOs underpricing is more severe for firms headquartered in areas with a recent local newspaper closure. Local newspapers play a crucial role in providing information to national media, as national newspapers mention private firms looking to go public less frequently if they are headquartered in areas that experience a local newspaper closure. The closure effect is driven by IPOs headquartered in areas with few alternative local newspapers or that are underwritten by highly reputable banks. In line with weak information processing, the stock prices of public firms located in areas with few alternative newspapers react to market news with a delay after a newspaper closes.

detail.abstract:
Background: COVID-19 vaccines played a critical role in reducing global health burden during the COVID-19 pandemic, but their rapid development required extraordinary effort. This study aims to evaluate their global return-on-investment (ROI) during the first year of the vaccination programme (8 December 2020-8 December 2021) to provide insights into the economic benefits relative to the costs of vaccine development, manufacturing, and delivery.

Methods: Public health outcomes of COVID-19 vaccination, including life years and QALYs gained from averted death, infections, and hospitalisations, were estimated. Health benefits were converted to economic benefits using welfarist and extra-welfarist approaches. These benefits were compared to the costs of vaccine development, manufacturing, and delivery to estimate the ROI under both approaches. Probabilistic sensitivity analyses were conducted to assess the impact of parameter uncertainty on ROI estimates.

Findings: Vaccine development and delivery cost $79.4 billion, but the health and economic benefits of vaccination were valued between $4.83 trillion–$37.8 trillion. High-income countries saw the greatest health benefits per-person vaccinated, and low-income countries gained the greatest non-health benefits per-person vaccinated, when expressed as a proportion of GDP per capita. This estimated ROIs of $59.8–$475 per dollar invested. ROIs ranged between $62.2–$442 across all sensitivity analyses for both approaches.

Interpretation: Rapid COVID-19 vaccine development and delivery were an excellent investment. Vaccine development and equitable vaccine distribution globally should be prioritised before and during global health crises.

detail.abstract: This study explores preferences for work-from-home (WFH) among U.S. wage and salaried workers in the post-COVID era with a focus on gender and managerial heterogeneity. Using data from the Survey of Working Arrangements and Attitudes collected between April 2023 and January 2024, we analyze how demographic and work-related factors influence WFH preferences. Our findings reveal that women generally express a stronger preference for WFH than men. However, a nuanced picture emerges for female managers, particularly those aged 40 and older, who prefer fewer WFH days compared to non-manager women. Furthermore, we find that higher education, the presence of children, higher incomes, and racial minority groups (specifically Black and Hispanic individuals) are positively associated with a greater desire for WFH. These findings underscore the complex interplay among individual circumstances, the pursuit of work-life balance, leadership approaches, and persistent gender norms within households and workplaces that shape WFH preferences. Understanding these factors is crucial for organizations to design inclusive workplace policies and cultures that benefit both employees and the organization.

detail.abstract: This paper uses U.S. TRI data on industrial air lead emissions to provide IV estimates of the e?ects of air lead concentration on infant mortality. The causal e?ect of lead on infant mortality is identified by variation in air fugitive lead emissions interacted with wind speed near reporting plants, which together determine local ambient lead concentration. Unlike stack emissions, which occur routinely and may prompt avoidance behavior, fugitive emissions are intermittent and influenced by both historical and current factors, such as wind speed variation, making them di?cult to avoid. The paper has two main findings. First, higher air lead concentration causes higher infant mortality in the first month and in the first year, suggesting that both in utero and environmental exposures matter. Second, higher lead concentration increases deaths from low birthweight, sudden unexplained infant death, and respiratory and nervous system causes, which is consistent with findings from animal studies, even when accounting for behavioral responses. Back of the envelope calculations indicate that declines in industrial air lead emissions prevented 300+ infant deaths per year, generating benefits of $3.5+ billion annually in 2023 dollars.

title: Mutual Reputation and Trust in a Repeated Sender-Receiver Game

detail.title: Mutual Reputation and Trust in a Repeated Sender-Receiver Game
detail.abstract: We study a repeated sender-receiver game where inspections are public but the sender's action is hidden unless inspected. A detected deception ends the relationship or triggers a finite punishment. We show the public state is one dimensional and prove existence of a stationary equilibrium with cutoff inspection and monotone deception. The sender's mixing pins down a closed-form total inspection probability at the cutoff, and a finite punishment phase implements the same cutoffs as termination. We extend to noisy checks, silent audits, and rare public alarms, preserving the Markov structure and continuity as transparency vanishes or becomes full. The model yields testable implications for auditing, certification, and platform governance: tapering inspections with reputation, bunching of terminations after inspection spurts, and sharper cutoffs as temptation rises relative to costs.

detail.abstract: This is a communication submitted to the Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court pursuant to the authority of Article 15 of the Rome Statute. It describes a widespread and intentional pattern of attacks directed against protected medical personnel (both military and civilian) as well as against medical facilities and vehicles. Medical personnel must be protected at all times in order to provide treatment on an ethical basis to all persons injured during the course of armed conflicts. Russian attackers have repeatedly employed a 'double tap' pattern whereby first responders of all nations and legal status are targeted in the aftermath of deliberate Russian attacks. The Russian Way of War seeks to leverage the deprivation of medical assistance and humanitarian relief into a cascading series of broader consequences that sap Ukrainian military and political efforts. Russian Total War is an attack on the structure of modern society and remains criminal in an array of discrete ways as explicated in this submission. This submission is made by Dentons and the Vanderbilt University Law School on behalf of the Nobel Prize Laureate Center for Civil Liberties in Ukraine. These abhorrent attacks merit the uncategorical condemnation of all states. Orchestrated Russian attacks against medical personnel and infrastructure began very shortly after the large scale invasion in February 2022 and have taken place across Ukraine, and far from the front lines in many instances. This pattern reflects a refinement of Russian tactics employed against targets in Syria and includes recurring use of precision munitions. This submission includes an extensive  Annex to help investigators and prosecutors create a chronology of attacks that constitute the crime base.  The OTP should investigate these offenses and charge the appropriate perpetrators in accordance with its fundamental mandate.

detail.title: Reputation, Risk, and Visibility
detail.abstract: When does reputation make experts play it safe, and what policy reverses that? I isolate a single lever-visibility of outcomes. In a two-page model with binary signals and outcomes, I show: (i) with an uninformative safe option and symmetric visibility, career concerns alone do not generate conservatism; (ii) increasing failure visibility (as in Registered Reports) weakens high-reputation caution and relaxes selection. I provide a necessary-and-sufficient local sign test, agnostic about utility curvature and allowing informative safe actions, and an identification map suitable for staggered RR adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了声誉如何影响专家决策保守性，发现结果可见性是关键因素。在对称可见性下，职业关注不会导致保守主义；而增加失败可见性（如注册报告）会减少高声誉专家的谨慎行为并放宽选择。
AI.research_question: 声誉何时会使专家采取保守策略？什么政策可以改变这种行为？
AI.motivation: 理解专家在声誉压力下的决策行为，特别是如何通过政策设计来改善专家的风险承担行为
AI.theoretical_framework: 职业关注理论，声誉模型，二元信号和结果框架
AI.method: 两期模型分析，二元信号和结果设定，必要充分局部符号检验
AI.findings: 1) 在对称可见性和无信息安全选项下，职业关注本身不会产生保守主义；2) 增加失败可见性（如注册报告）会削弱高声誉专家的谨慎行为并放宽选择
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个不依赖效用曲率且允许信息性安全行为的必要充分局部符号检验方法，以及适用于交错注册报告采用的识别映射
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过调整结果可见性来改善专家风险承担行为的理论依据，特别是注册报告制度的有效性

title: Largest Employer needs a Level Playing Field
affiliations: Peking University and Peking First Advisory Co Ltd

detail.title: Largest Employer needs a Level Playing Field
detail.abstract: Largest employer needs a level playing field By Dong Xian'an, president and chief economist at Peking First Advisory on 1st June 2011. China's broad private sector provides more than 90 percent of the 800 million jobs in the world's second-largest economy. That includes 237 million created by domestic private firms in urban areas, 18 million created by foreigninvested firms and 470 million rural jobs. In the early years after the founding of the People's Republic of China, most jobs were offered by State-owned companies, which once created a record high of 78.9 percent of total urban jobs in 1976. However, with reform and opening-up, private firms started to mushroom, creating more and more jobs, and eventually overtaking the State firms as the biggest employer. It addresses the discriminatory policies should be abolished.

AI.tldr: 中国私营部门已成为最大的就业提供者，创造了全国90%以上的就业岗位，但面临政策歧视问题需要解决
AI.research_question: 中国私营部门在就业创造中的作用及其面临的政策环境问题
AI.motivation: 分析私营部门在中国就业市场中的主导地位，揭示其面临的歧视性政策问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 就业创造理论、所有制改革理论、市场公平竞争理论
AI.method: 基于历史数据和统计数据的描述性分析
AI.findings: 私营部门创造了全国90%以上的就业（8亿个工作岗位），其中城镇私营企业2.37亿个、外资企业1800万个、农村就业4.7亿个；而国有企业就业比例从1976年的78.9%大幅下降
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了市场化改革对就业结构的影响，提出了公平竞争环境对私营部门发展的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供废除歧视性政策、建立公平竞争环境的依据，促进私营部门更好发挥就业创造作用

title: Pipeline vs. Choice: The Global Gender Gap in STEM Applications
affiliations: , Stockholm University - Swedish Institute for Social Research (SOFI), University of Melbourne - Department of Economics, London School of Economics, VATT Institute for Economic Research, University of Glasgow, National Taiwan University, Monash University - Department of Economics, , New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. detail.title: Pipeline vs. Choice: The Global Gender Gap in STEM Applications

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Women account for only 35% of global STEM graduates, a share that has remained unchanged for a decade. We use administrative microdata from centralized university admissions in ten systems to deliver the first cross-national decomposition of the STEM gender gap into a pipeline gap (academic preparedness) and a choice gap (first-choice field conditional on eligibility). In deferred-acceptance platforms where eligibility is score-based, we isolate preferences from access. The pipeline gap varies widely, from -19 to +31 percentage points across education systems. By contrast, the choice gap is remarkably stable: high-scoring women are 25 percentage points less likely than men to rank STEM first.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析10个国家的大学招生数据，首次将STEM领域的性别差距分解为管道差距（学术准备度）和选择差距（符合资格条件下的首选专业选择），发现选择差距在不同教育体系中保持稳定，高分数女性选择STEM专业的可能性比男性低25个百分点。
AI.research_question: 全球STEM毕业生中女性比例为何长期停滞在35%？如何分解STEM性别差距为学术准备差距和专业选择差距？
AI.motivation: 过去十年全球STEM毕业生中女性比例一直维持在35%且没有改善，需要深入理解这一性别差距的结构性原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于延迟接受招生平台的理论框架，利用分数基础的资格认定来分离偏好因素和准入因素。
AI.method: 使用10个教育体系的集中化大学招生行政微观数据，进行跨国分解分析。
AI.findings: 管道差距（学术准备度）在不同教育体系中差异巨大（-19到+31个百分点），而选择差距（符合资格条件下的专业选择）异常稳定，高分数女性选择STEM作为首选专业的可能性比男性低25个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并实证验证了STEM性别差距的管道-选择二分法分解框架，为理解性别差异提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供了针对性干预的方向：需要重点关注女性在符合资格条件下仍不愿选择STEM专业的选择偏好问题，而不仅仅是提高学术准备度。

title: A Regression Multivariate Correlated Poisson Generalized Inverse Gaussian Model for Dependent Count Data: Estimation and Testing Procedures
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember and Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember

detail.title: A Regression Multivariate Correlated Poisson Generalized Inverse Gaussian Model for Dependent Count Data: Estimation and Testing Procedures

keywords: Multivariate Correlated Poisson Generalized Inverse Gaussian (MCPGIG)

detail.abstract: Regression modeling for multivariate count data often struggles with issues of overdispersion and correlation among response variables. The standard Poisson regression framework assumes independence and equidispersion, making it less suitable for complex, real-world count outcomes. To address these limitations, this study proposes a new model called Multivariate Correlated Poisson Generalized Inverse Gaussian Regression (MCPGIGR), which integrates random effects through common shock variables and allows for flexible mean structures via a log-link function.This research develops a maximum likelihood estimation algorithm for MCPGIGR and introduces Maximum Likelihood Ratio Tests to evaluate both simultaneous and partial significance of predictors. The model is further extended by incorporating exposure variables to accommodate differences in observation time or population at risk.We conduct simulation studies to assess the consistency and performance of the proposed estimators. Furthermore, the MCPGIGR model is applied to real-world data on maternal and neonatal mortality in East Java, Indonesia, providing insights into health disparities across regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了MCPGIGR模型来解决多元计数数据的过离散和相关性问题，通过最大似然估计和模拟研究验证了模型性能，并应用于印度尼西亚母婴死亡率数据分析。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够有效处理多元计数数据过离散和相关性的回归模型？
AI.motivation: 标准泊松回归假设独立性和等离散性，不适用于复杂的现实世界计数结果，需要开发更灵活的模型来处理这些限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于共同冲击变量的随机效应整合和通过对数链接函数的灵活均值结构，构建多元相关泊松广义逆高斯回归框架。
AI.method: 开发最大似然估计算法，引入最大似然比检验评估预测变量的同时和部分显著性，并通过模拟研究评估估计量的一致性和性能。
AI.findings: MCPGIGR模型能够有效处理多元计数数据的过离散和相关性，在模拟研究中表现出良好的估计性能，并在实际母婴死亡率数据分析中提供了有价值的区域健康差异洞察。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的MCPGIGR模型理论框架，扩展了多元计数数据的建模方法，为处理相关性和过离散问题提供了理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的估计算法和检验方法，模型可应用于公共卫生等领域的多元计数数据分析，如母婴死亡率研究，为政策制定提供数据支持。

title: MPRe: Multi-scale Feature Guided Prototype Reconstruction for Few-Shot Fine-Grained Image Classification
affiliations: Wuhan University of Technology, Wuhan University of Technology, Wuhan University and Wuhan University of Technology

detail.title: MPRe: Multi-scale Feature Guided Prototype Reconstruction for Few-Shot Fine-Grained Image Classification
detail.abstract: Few-Shot Fine-Grained Image Classification (FS-FGIC) presents unique challenges due to the need for recognizing subtle inter-class differences from only a handful of samples. While recent methods have made progress by extracting local or high-level discriminative cues within single tasks, they often suffer from two limitations. On the one hand, they tend to over-rely on local features, which can introduce noise and become unreliable under pose variation or occlusion; alternatively, some methods focus solely on extracting high-level semantic features, which are often insufficient to distinguish fine-grained categories with subtle inter-class differences. On the other hand, they struggle with poor generalization caused by the distribution shift between support and query samples. To address these challenges, we propose a novel method called Multi-scale Prototype Reconstruction (MPRe). From the perspective of fine-grained classification, we introduce a Multi-scale Feature Interaction Module (MFIM) that fuses global semantics, contextual structures, and fine-grained details across layers through a three-branch attention mechanism, enhancing robustness to appearance variation. From the few-shot learning perspective, we design a Prototype Reconstruction Module (PRM) to reduce the support-query distribution gap via channel-spatial augment, similarity weighting, and query-guided prototype adaptation. Extensive experiments on five benchmark FS-FGIC datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly under the challenging 1-shot setting, validating the effectiveness of our design in improving both robustness and generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为多尺度原型重建（MPRe）的新方法来解决小样本细粒度图像分类中的挑战，通过多尺度特征交互模块和原型重建模块，在五个基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在小样本细粒度图像分类中同时解决局部特征噪声问题、高层语义特征不足问题以及支持-查询样本分布偏移导致的泛化能力差的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有方法在FS-FGIC中存在两个主要局限：一是过度依赖局部特征（易受姿态变化和遮挡影响）或仅关注高层语义特征（难以区分细粒度类别）；二是支持样本与查询样本之间的分布偏移导致泛化能力差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于小样本学习和细粒度图像分类理论，结合多尺度特征融合和原型重建机制，构建了双视角解决方案。
AI.method: 提出MPRe方法，包含两个核心模块：1）多尺度特征交互模块（MFIM）- 通过三分支注意力机制融合全局语义、上下文结构和细粒度细节；2）原型重建模块（PRM）- 通过通道-空间增强、相似性加权和查询引导的原型适应来减少分布差距。
AI.findings: 在五个FS-FGIC基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法实现了最先进的性能，特别是在具有挑战性的1-shot设置下，验证了其在提高鲁棒性和泛化能力方面的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了双视角（细粒度分类视角和小样本学习视角）的集成解决方案；2）发展了多尺度特征交互和原型重建的理论框架；3）为小样本细粒度分类提供了新的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发了实用的MPRe方法，可直接应用于各种细粒度图像分类任务；2）在多个基准数据集上展示了优异的性能；3）特别是在1-shot设置下的突出表现，为实际应用中样本稀缺的场景提供了有效解决方案。

detail.title: Spatial Heterogeneity in Machine Learning-Based Poverty Mapping: Where Do Models Underperform?

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 798
publicationDetails.journalName: ADB Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Recent studies harnessing geospatial big data and machine learning have significantly advanced poverty mapping, enabling granular and timely welfare estimates in traditionally datascarce regions. While much of the existing research has focused on overall out-of-sample predictive performance, there is a lack of understanding regarding where such models underperform and whether key spatial relationships might vary across places. This study investigates spatial heterogeneity in machine learning-based poverty mapping, testing whether spatial regression and machine learning techniques produce more unbiased predictions. We find that extrapolation into unsurveyed areas suffers from biases that spatial methods do not resolve; welfare is overestimated in impoverished regions, rural areas, and single sector-dominated economies, whereas it tends to be underestimated in wealthier, urbanized, and diversified economies. Even as spatial models improve overall predictive accuracy, enhancements in traditionally underperforming areas remain marginal. This underscores the need for more representative training datasets and better remotely sensed proxies, especially for poor and rural regions, in future research related to machine learning-based poverty mapping.

AI.tldr: 机器学习贫困地图存在空间异质性偏差，空间回归方法无法完全解决外推偏差问题，贫困地区、农村和单一经济部门地区的福利被高估，而富裕、城市化和多元化经济地区则被低估。
AI.research_question: 机器学习贫困地图是否存在空间异质性？空间回归和机器学习技术是否能产生更无偏的预测？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注整体预测性能，缺乏对模型在何处表现不佳以及关键空间关系是否因地而异的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间异质性理论、机器学习预测偏差理论、地理空间大数据分析框架
AI.method: 使用地理空间大数据和机器学习技术，结合空间回归方法进行贫困地图预测分析
AI.findings: 外推到未调查区域存在偏差，贫困地区、农村和单一经济部门地区的福利被高估，而富裕、城市化和多元化经济地区被低估；空间模型虽提高整体预测精度，但对传统表现不佳区域的改善有限
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了机器学习贫困地图的空间异质性特征，提出了预测偏差的空间分布规律
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要更具代表性的训练数据集和更好的遥感代理指标，特别是在贫困和农村地区，为未来基于机器学习的贫困地图研究提供实践指导

title: The Digital Gender Divide in Germany: The Role of Preferences and Constraints in Digital Involvement and Wages
affiliations: University of Erlangen-Nuremberg, Friedrich Alexander University Erlangen Nuremberg, Friedrich Alexander University Erlangen Nuremberg, Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg and Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg

detail.title: The Digital Gender Divide in Germany: The Role of Preferences and Constraints in Digital Involvement and Wages

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the digital gender divide (DGD) in Germany by analyzing gendered patterns of digital technology use in both private and professional contexts, and their consequences for wages. Using data from the GESIS Panel, we construct a Digital Involvement at Work index covering ten technologies to assess both active use and passive exposure. Our results reveal a significant DGD in the workplace: women are consistently less involved with digital technologies at work, even after controlling for education, occupational qualification, and digital affinity. In contrast, private digital use appears more balanced. This suggests that structural constraints—rather than individual preferences—play a key role in shaping the divide. Further, we find that digital involvement is positively associated with individual income, yet it does not close the gender pay gap (GPG). On the contrary, digital involvement yields greater wage returns for men than for women. These findings highlight how gendered patterns of digitalization in the workplace reinforce existing inequalities. We conclude with a discussion of the implications for policy and labor market equity, emphasizing the need for measures that promote equitable digital inclusion.

AI.tldr: 德国数字性别鸿沟研究：女性在工作场所数字技术参与度显著低于男性，这种差异主要源于结构性约束而非个人偏好，数字参与虽然与收入正相关但未能缩小性别薪酬差距，反而对男性的工资回报更高
AI.research_question: 德国数字性别鸿沟在工作场所和私人环境中的表现如何？数字技术使用对性别薪酬差距有何影响？
AI.motivation: 探究数字技术使用中的性别差异及其对劳动力市场不平等的影响，特别是在数字化转型背景下理解性别鸿沟的机制和后果
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字性别鸿沟理论、劳动力市场性别分层理论、技术采纳与使用差异理论
AI.method: 使用GESIS面板数据，构建包含10种技术的"工作场所数字参与指数"，区分主动使用和被动接触，控制教育、职业资格和数字亲和力等因素
AI.findings: 1) 工作场所存在显著数字性别鸿沟，女性数字参与度更低；2) 私人数字使用相对平衡；3) 数字参与与收入正相关但未能缩小性别薪酬差距；4) 数字参与对男性的工资回报更高
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字性别鸿沟的结构性根源，挑战了个人偏好解释，提出了数字技术使用差异强化现有不平等的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供实证依据，强调需要促进公平数字包容的措施，对劳动力市场性别平等政策具有重要启示

title: Forging a Moral Basis for Emerging Economies
affiliations: Seton Hall University

detail.title: Forging a Moral Basis for Emerging Economies
detail.abstract: Aristotle said that politics is the master science. What he calls politics is not what is now called political science but the culmination of ethics. Per Aristotle, economics, a dimension of ethics, posits the eudaimonia (human flourishing or well-being, erroneously translated as happiness) or summum bonum for human society and describes the regional structures of human social existence. Economics cannot, therefore, be a positive science but must be a normative science. Morality has disappeared from economics being taught at American universities. The prevailing paradigm adopted by mainstream economics is Homo Economicus, which is the "wrong reduction of a man." Such a gross reduction of a human into a rational agent who maximizes his utility subject to the given budget constraint leaves dormant higher human values (compassion, empathy, brotherhood, and sisterhood, to name a few), and this mechanical decision-maker is likely to destroy himself and the society in which he operates. Economics (taught and practiced in America) is the fish that has jumped out of its pond and is now dying of thirst. Ethics is the water that gives it life. The best way to save it is to bring economics back to the pond where it belongs. What is truly needed is a paradigm shift in the teaching and practice of economics. Last but not least, economists in emerging countries should forge a moral basis for their national economy and form a vision of how to construct a system of political economy that will achieve the maximum well-being of the citizens and social justice. In doing so, they should synthesize their normative value judgments with scientific perspectives in economics. Old, labelled models like capitalism and socialism are modifiable constructs.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文控诉主流经济学的Homo Economicus范式，指出经济学应该是规范科学而非实证科学，需要重新融入伦理价值观以促进人类繁荣和社会正义。
AI.research_question: 为什么主流经济学的Homo Economicus范式是错误的？如何将伦理价值重新融入经济学教学和实践？
AI.motivation: 现代经济学弃置了道德伦理基础，将人类简化为理性效用最大化的机器，忽视了同情、慈悲等高级人性价值，对个人和社会造成危害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亚里士多德的政治哲学理论，认为政治是伦理学的高级形式，经济学作为伦理学的一部分应该是规范科学，目标是人类繁荣(eudaimonia)。
AI.method: 哲学性分析和理论批判，通过对亚里士多德思想的重新解读，指出现代经济学的理论偏差。
AI.findings: 现代经济学的Homo Economicus模型是对人性的错误简化，弃置了道德伦理基础，如同鱼跳出池塘而死亡。经济学需要重新融入伦理价值观才能获得生命力。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义经济学的本质属性，提出经济学应作为规范科学而非实证科学，为经济学的范式转移提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议发展中国家的经济学家为国家经济构建道德基础，将规范价值判断与科学视角融合，创建能够实现公民最大福祷和社会正义的政治经济体系。

title: Returns to ICT Skills in European Labour Markets, Trade Unions and Contractual Cleavages
affiliations: IRVAPP, Trento University and AFI-IPL

detail.title: Returns to ICT Skills in European Labour Markets, Trade Unions and Contractual Cleavages
detail.abstract: In the last decades, socio-economic literature has paid considerable attention to the distribution of costs and benefits of technological introduction and ICT diffusion for different segments of the workforce, mainly across distinct occupational or educational groups. This study explores how wage returns to ICT use differ between temporary and permanent workers focusing on the role of trade unions in mitigating this contractual divide. Using recent European microdata from the ESJ2 survey (CEDEFOP 2022), we examine whether union membership enhances wage outcomes for temporary workers using digital skills, and how this effect varies depending on national patterns of union representation. By combining individual-level information with country-level indicators of trade union density across contractual types, we assess how micro and macro level dynamics shape wage parity in ICT returns. Overall, our findings reveal a clear penalty for non-unionised temporary workers. The protective role of trade union membership is nonetheless significant only in national contexts characterized by similar level of trade union density across contractual groups. These results underscore both the conditionalities and potentials of industrial relations in fostering inclusive labour markets amid technological change.

title: Time Series Forecasting of International Tourist Arrivals Using ARIMA: A Case Study on Long-Term Trends and Post-Disruption Recovery

detail.title: Time Series Forecasting of International Tourist Arrivals Using ARIMA: A Case Study on Long-Term Trends and Post-Disruption Recovery
detail.abstract: This study aims to analyze tourism trends in the region before the COVID-19 pandemic, compare tourist arrival trends before and after the pandemic, and forecast future international tourist arrivals up to 2030. Thailand is used as a case study for a comprehensive examination of these trends. Data from the World Bank and the Bank of Thailand were analyzed, covering 1995–2020 for Southeast Asia and post-pandemic data for Thailand. Standardized data collection and preprocessing ensured consistency, with missing values addressed through interpolation and smoothing techniques. Temporal segmentation structured the dataset into pre- and post-pandemic periods. The ARIMA model was selected based on statistical tests, capturing trends and short-term fluctuations in Thailand's international tourist arrivals. Model accuracy was validated, and a 10-year forecast (2025–2034) was generated. The findings indicate that, before the pandemic, international visitor arrivals from Southeast Asia were on a significant upward trend, driven by multiple factors. However, the pandemic led to a sharp decline due to widespread travel restrictions and safety concerns. Nevertheless, the case study of Thailand shows a steady post-pandemic recovery, with Chinese and Malaysian tourists remaining key source markets. Widespread immunization campaigns and quarantine-free entry programs, such as the Phuket Sandbox, Samui Plus, and Phuket Sandbox 7+7 Extension, contributed to rebuilding travel confidence. Visa-free allowances for specific nations further encouraged the return of international tourists. Projections indicate that foreign visitor arrivals in Thailand will grow from 18.23 million in 2025 to over 21.08 million by 2034. These forecasts serve as critical benchmarks for tourism policy formulation, marketing strategies, and long-term sustainable tourism development planning in Thailand and other Southeast Asian countries.

title:
k
<sup>R</sup>: A Functional Reactive Extension to the k Programming Language
affiliations: Thalesians

detail.title:
k
<sup>R</sup>: A Functional Reactive Extension to the k Programming Language
detail.abstract: We propose kR, a conservative extension of the APL-like array language k that adds a precise, denotational semantics for Functional Reactive Programming (FRP) while preserving k’s minimal syntax and rank-polymorphic array operators. The design introduces two reactive abstractions—behaviours (time-varying values) and event streams (time-stamped occurrences)—a minimal k-flavoured API (.r.*) including sample/hold/switch, and a deterministic, glitch-free operational semantics based on macro-ticks, microsteps, and explicit delays. We show how ordinary k verbs lift pointwise over time, formalise causality and fixed-point conditions for cyclic graphs, present an optional arrowised layer, and detail an implementation strategy compatible with columnar streaming workloads (e.g., market data). Case studies (VWAP, GUI counters, DSP toy) illustrate expressiveness. To our knowledge, this is the first public formulation of full FRP (in the Elliott–Hudak sense) integrated into k/q-style languages.

AI.tldr: k^R是APL类数组语言k的保守扩展，为函数式响应式编程(FRP)添加精确的指称语义，同时保持k的极简语法和秩多态数组操作符。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Elliott-Hudak的完整FRP理论框架，结合指称语义和操作语义，使用行为(behaviours)和事件流(event streams)作为核心抽象。
AI.method: 设计k^R语言扩展，引入.r.* API，基于宏时钟、微步和显式延迟的操作语义，并进行案例研究(VWAP、GUI计数器、DSP玩具)验证表达能力。
AI.findings: 成功实现了k语言的FRP扩展，保持了原有的语法简洁性和数组操作能力，同时提供了确定性、无毛刺的响应式编程语义。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在k/q风格语言中完整实现了FRP，形式化了因果关系和循环图的定点条件，提出了可选箭头化层。

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We show that separation has been a relevant outcome of American relationships over the last century and that separated women have worse economic outcomes than those divorced. A transferable-utility model of marriage, separation and divorce indicates that the welfare effects of divorce legislation depend on considering separation as an alternative. Empirically, the adoption of unilateral divorce laws reduced separation and increased divorce, particularly among low-educated women. A calibrated model indicates heterogeneous welfare effects of unilateral divorce with gains being concentrated among women with lower education. Desertion laws with very short duration generate similar gains for women.

title: Financial Sophistication: Examining Pricing and Risk from Credit Card Balance Transfers

detail.title: Financial Sophistication: Examining Pricing and Risk from Credit Card Balance Transfers
detail.abstract: We study the effect of financial sophistication on consumer credit. Inferring financial sophistication through the use of a credit card strategy that phased out with the CARD Act in 2008, we use a difference-in-difference framework to find that borrowers who did not take advantage of the strategy exhibited greater credit card delinquencies, equivalent to 158 lower points of credit score. This additional risk was not priced through higher interest rates or loan terms at origination, although interest rates and credit scores for those less sophisticated quickly deteriorated post-origination. By matching to credit bureau data, we find significant spillovers from domain-specific credit card sophistication to higher delinquency risks for auto and mortgage loans. We also find that the CARD Act was successful in reducing some of the costs of being financially less sophisticated, with average credit card-related costs falling by $140 for those less sophisticated.

title: Bivariate Distribution Regression; Theory, Estimation and an Application to Intergenerational Mobility
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, Boston University - Department of Economics, Swiss National Bank, VU University Amsterdam - Department of Economics and Georgetown University

detail.title: Bivariate Distribution Regression; Theory, Estimation and an Application to Intergenerational Mobility

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We employ distribution regression to estimate the joint distribution of two outcome variables conditional on covariates. Bivariate Distribution Regression (BDR) is particularly valuable when some dependence between the outcomes persists after accounting for the impact of the covariates. Our analysis relies on  Chernozhukov et al. (2018) which shows that any conditional joint distribution has a local Gaussian representation. We describe how BDR can be implemented and present some functionals of interest. As modeling the unexplained dependence is a key feature of BDR, we focus on functionals related to this dependence. We decompose the difference between the joint distributions for different groups into composition, marginal and sorting effects. We provide a similar decomposition for the transition matrices which describe how location in the distribution of one outcome is associated with location in the other. Our theoretical contributions are the derivation of the properties of these estimated functionals and appropriate procedures for inference. Our empirical illustration focuses on intergenerational mobility. Using the Panel Survey of Income Dynamics data, we model the joint distribution of parents and childrens earnings.

detail.title: A Topology of Educational Outcome Inequality
detail.abstract: This paper examines educational inequality using the Education Gini Index alongside Topological Data Analysis Ball Mapper. A ward-level empirical case study of Greater Manchester and Merseyside identifies clear socio-demographic patterns beyond pure spatial differences. Wards with higher educational inequality are characterised by higher deprivation, larger young populations, and greater ethnic diversity. In contrast, low-inequality areas are more socioeconomically stable. Wards with differing levels of inequality are often geographic neighbours. This paper demonstrates how TDA Ball Mapper preserves complex, multidimensional relationships without dimensionality reduction, enabling the detection of distinct clusters of educational inequality across regions. The analysis highlights the need for targeted educational policies to address entrenched inequalities. The implementation casts light on the opportunities to implement such targeted policies.

publicationDetails.detailsText: 'Building a Just AI Ecosystem in Africa' RIA Conference Paper, South Africa (July 2024)

detail.abstract: The expansion of Artificial Intelligence (AI) use across markets globally and in Africa poses exciting opportunities but also presents risks to economic policy making especially competition policy. We motivate why AI policy should be adopted within a competition framework to ensure that markets remain open, fair, and competitive. This means AI policy adopted should still provide leeway for small businesses and would-be competitors to participate freely in markets. Through a review of literature and network analysis of an AI ecosystem network, this paper finds that i) The AI ecosystem and its related input markets are prone to increasing concentration ii) There is the need to better understand AI especially how it may affect levels of competition in the AI ecosystem. This is necessary because of the integrated nature of the AI ecosystem, which produces economies of scope and scale for centrally positioned players. Thus, the continued expansion of these players may be to the detriment of smaller African AI ecosystem participants. We conclude with recommendations on appropriate regulatory responses that ensure that AI policies are designed and implemented based on a competitive framework that adopts a whole-of-government approach to promoting competition in the African AI ecosystem.

detail.title: Intergroup Cooperation and Reputation for Honesty in an OLG Framework
detail.abstract: This paper studies an infinite-horizon framework in which two large populations of players are randomly matched to play a Prisoner's Dilemma. Each player lives for two consecutive periods: as a young player from one group, and then as an old player in the other group. Each population has a known fraction of honest types-individuals who always cooperate unless paired with a player who has been observed to defect against a cooperating partner in the past. Because such defections (i.e., breakdowns of trust) are publicly observed, any defector risks carrying a stigma into future interactions. We show that when the benefits from defection are sufficiently large, there exists an equilibrium in which an increase in the fraction of honest types can reduce the likelihood of cooperation. Moreover, we demonstrate that introducing imperfect public memory-allowing past misdeeds to be probabilistically "cleared"-does not enhance cooperation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个无限期界框架，其中两个大型玩家群体随机匹配进行囚徒困境博弈。每个玩家经历两个连续时期：年轻时属于一个群体，年老时属于另一个群体。每个群体都有已知比例的诚实类型个体，他们总是合作，除非遇到过去曾被观察到对合作伙伴背叛的玩家。由于这种背叛（即信任破裂）是公开观察到的，任何背叛者都可能在未来的互动中背负污名。研究表明，当背叛收益足够大时，存在一种均衡，其中诚实类型比例的增加反而会降低合作的可能性。此外，引入不完美的公共记忆（允许过去的错误行为被概率性地"清除"）并不能促进合作。
AI.research_question: 在具有世代交替和诚实类型玩家的囚徒困境博弈中，诚实类型比例的增加如何影响合作行为？不完美的公共记忆是否能够促进合作？
AI.motivation: 研究在重复互动中信任和声誉机制如何影响合作行为，特别是在存在世代交替和不同类型玩家的复杂社会环境中
AI.theoretical_framework: 无限期界博弈理论、囚徒困境、声誉机制、世代交替模型、进化博弈论
AI.method: 理论建模和均衡分析，构建包含两个大型群体、世代交替结构、诚实类型玩家和公共观察机制的博弈论框架
AI.findings: 1) 当背叛收益足够大时，诚实类型比例的增加反而会降低合作的可能性；2) 引入不完美的公共记忆（允许过去错误被概率性清除）并不能促进合作
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在具有世代交替和声誉机制的环境中，增加"好人"比例可能产生反直觉的负面效果，挑战了传统关于诚实类型促进合作的直觉
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实世界中信任机制和声誉系统的设计提供了理论洞见，特别是在需要考虑世代交替和不同类型行为者的社会环境中

title: A Taste of Communists' Own Medicine: The Political Consequences of Land Reforms in Japan and Taiwan
affiliations: University of Rochester, National Taiwan University and University of California, Davis

detail.title: A Taste of Communists' Own Medicine: The Political Consequences of Land Reforms in Japan and Taiwan

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Postwar land reforms in East Asia were implemented as a geopolitical strategy to curb communism expansion. This paper evaluates their long-term political effects in Japan and Taiwan. In Japan, reform increased support for conservative parties and reduced backing for socialist and communist factions, with intergenerational persistence. Taiwans reform similarly bolstered electoral support for the Kuomintang. IV analyses support a causal interpretation. Survey evidence suggests that land acquisition fostered a desire for political stability as the mechanism, rather than through reciprocity or pro-market ideology. These findings highlight land reforms critical role in shaping postwar political alignment and deflecting communist influence.

AI.tldr: 战后东亚土地改革作为遏制共产主义扩张的地缘政治策略，对日本和台湾产生了长期政治影响：增加了保守政党支持度，减少了社会主义和共产主义派系支持，且具有代际持续性。
AI.research_question: 战后东亚土地改革的长期政治效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 评估作为遏制共产主义扩张地缘政治策略的土地改革对日本和台湾的长期政治影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治理论、政治稳定理论、土地改革政治效应理论
AI.method: 工具变量分析（IV分析）、调查证据分析
AI.findings: 日本土地改革增加了保守政党支持度，减少了社会主义和共产主义派系支持，具有代际持续性；台湾改革同样增强了国民党选举支持度
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了土地改革通过培养政治稳定需求而非互惠或亲市场意识形态的机制来影响政治联盟
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了土地改革在塑造战后政治联盟和抵制共产主义影响中的关键作用
